title: Amazon’s 10th Prime Day Event Returns July 16 & 17, With Millions of Exclusive Deals for Prime Members
summary: Amazon's 10th Prime Day event will take place on July 16-17, offering millions of exclusive deals for Prime members across various categories, including electronics, beauty, and apparel. Customers can expect new deals dropping frequently and early access to "Invite-only" deals on select items. Influencers like Megan Thee Stallion and others are promoting early deals and products leading up to the event, with special savings opportunities for back-to-school shoppers and Prime Visa/Store Card holders.

title: Elizabeth Warren just accused Kroger of price gouging as 'families struggle to pay to put food on the table'
summary: Senator Elizabeth Warren has accused Kroger of potential price gouging due to its adoption of electronic shelving labels (ESLs), which allow for dynamic pricing. She and Senator Bob Casey argue that this technology could enable Kroger and other chains to manipulate grocery prices, akin to "airline tickets," making it harder for families to afford food. Kroger has denied these claims, stating that their business model aims to lower prices over time and that ESLs are not intended for price increases for consumers.

title: What is Amazon Prime? Subscription gets you free deliveries, movies and more
summary: Amazon Prime offers numerous benefits including free deliveries, streaming movies and music, and discounts, appealing to over 200 million members worldwide. The article details the cost of various Prime memberships, including discounted rates for students and those receiving government assistance, and helps readers determine if the subscription is worthwhile based on their spending and streaming habits. It also highlights the process to sign up for Amazon Prime, advising potential subscribers to try the free trial first.

title: Amazon’s AI spending plans keep stock from joining tech rebound
summary: Amazon's shares are lagging behind its megacap peers due to its substantial spending on artificial intelligence computing, which is impacting its profits. Investors are concerned that increased capital spending will negatively affect cash flows, especially as the company has historically performed better when focused on profitability. This shift to investment mode, coupled with Amazon's lack of a dividend and less aggressive share buyback program compared to competitors, is causing investors to pause on the stock.

title: Amazon raises stake in Grubhub, embeds food delivery in app
summary: Amazon has increased its stake in Grubhub to potentially 18% and integrated the food delivery service directly into its website and shopping app. This expanded partnership, a five-year agreement, allows US Amazon Prime members to receive a free Grubhub+ membership, aiming to significantly boost Grubhub's customer growth and help Amazon retain Prime subscribers. The deal positions Grubhub to combat declining market share and transaction values in North America, acting as a white-label service for Prime members without referral fees.

title: How AI Is Transforming Supply Chain Management
summary: This article explores how AI is transforming supply chain management by addressing its benefits, high-impact use cases, and risks. It highlights the importance of crafting a comprehensive AI strategy with four key pillars: vision, value, risks, and adoption. The article also discusses short-term GenAI use cases mapped to supply chain objectives and major areas of AI technology investment.

title: Amazon warehouse workers say they struggle to afford food, rent
summary: A new study reveals that despite Amazon.com Inc. raising wages to $15 an hour five years ago, half of its warehouse workers surveyed still struggle to afford food or housing. The study, conducted by the University of Illinois Chicago’s Center for Urban Economic Development, found high rates of food and housing insecurity among Amazon employees, with many relying on government assistance. This research fuels ongoing criticism of Amazon's employee treatment, particularly regarding working conditions and wage stagnation despite the company's growth.

title: Omnicom to Acquire Interpublic in Deal That Will Reshape Advertising Industry
summary: Omnicom Group is set to acquire Interpublic Group in an all-stock deal that will create the world's largest advertising business. The combined entity, retaining the Omnicom name, is projected to have net revenue exceeding $20 billion based on 2023 figures. This merger will bring together prominent ad agencies like TBWA Worldwide and McCann Worldgroup, serving major clients such as Amazon, AT&T, PepsiCo, Unilever, and Volkswagen.

title: Here's How Much $1000 Invested In Amazon.com 10 Years Ago Would Be Worth Today
summary: This article analyzes the hypothetical growth of a $1,000 investment in Amazon.com (NASDAQ: AMZN) made 10 years ago. It reveals that such an investment would now be worth $8,835.40, demonstrating Amazon's significant outperformance of the market with an average annual return of 24.32%. The piece highlights the powerful effect of compounded returns on investment growth.

title: |The usa "antitrust queen" is tightening her grip in the final moments of her term, investigating microsoft's cloud computing business.
summary: |The FTC, led by Chair Lina Khan, is investigating Microsoft's cloud computing business over allegations of unfair licensing terms that lock in customers. This probe comes as Khan aims to intensify antitrust actions before the end of the current administration. International regulators, including those in the UK and EU, have also scrutinized Microsoft's cloud practices.

title: Retailers Try on More Tech
summary: Retailers are entering a new phase of growth driven by AI and automation, according to Morgan Stanley. Key technologies like retail media, AI, and automation are expected to boost profitability and growth, particularly for larger retailers who can invest more in these advancements. This technological adoption will lead to margin expansion and consolidation within the retail sector.

title: Customers Scale Their Use of Amazon Q Business as New Innovations Transform How Employees Work
summary: AWS announced new capabilities for Amazon Q Business, a generative AI-powered assistant, that enhance insights across applications like Amazon Q in QuickSight and provide over 50 new actions for popular business tools. These innovations aim to automate complex workflows and simplify tasks, drastically improving employee efficiency. Companies such as Asana, GE HealthCare, Kepler, and Zoom are leveraging these advancements to transform how their employees work.

title: Amazon’s swelling cash pile makes conditions ripe for dividend
summary: Amazon's growing cash reserves, projected to exceed $100 billion this year, are leading many to believe that the e-commerce giant is poised to join other megacap companies in returning capital to shareholders, potentially through its first-ever dividend. Despite resistance from its CFO, investors anticipate a shift in strategy, especially given its relatively low buyback program compared to peers and the increasing trend of tech giants initiating or raising dividends. However, some analysts caution that Amazon's lower margins, due to its retail business, might make a dividend premature if it wants to maintain responsible stewardship.

title: Is The Trade Desk signaling the rebound of digital advertising?
summary: The Trade Desk (TTD) reported strong Q4 2023 earnings, exceeding lowered revenue guidance and raising Q1 2024 guidance, signaling a potential rebound in digital advertising. The company's AI-powered platform, Kokai, and its position in Connected TV (CTV) and shopper marketing are expected to drive future growth. Analysts have upgraded price targets, citing improved advertiser sentiment and a neutral to positive impact from Google's cookie deprecation.

title: Amazon Prime Day drives US online sales up 11% to $14.2 billion
summary: U.S. online sales during Amazon.com Inc.’s Prime Day event increased by 11% to $14.2 billion, matching estimates by Adobe Inc. Consumers capitalized on deep discounts across electronics, apparel, and home appliances. Although Amazon reported record items sold, the average household spending on Amazon during Prime Day slightly decreased from the previous year.

title: Amazon Black Friday 2024 sales event will start Nov. 21: See some of the deals
summary: Amazon's Black Friday 2024 sales event is set to begin on Thursday, November 21st, and will run through November 29th, followed by a Cyber Monday event from November 29th through December 2nd. Shoppers can anticipate significant discounts, including up to 55% off Amazon Fire Smart TVs, Echo devices, and various other Amazon devices, as well as deals on apparel, toys from popular brands, home appliances, and holiday decorations. Amazon Prime members will receive additional savings and free deliveries on select grocery items during the events.

title: Insight Buys ServiceNow All-Star Partner Infocenter; Bill McDermott Weighs In
summary: Insight Enterprises has acquired Infocenter, a top ServiceNow partner, to enhance its ServiceNow consulting and managed services capabilities and boost its automation portfolio. The acquisition aims to deliver AI-fueled intelligent workflow automation solutions and leverage Infocenter's expertise in various industries. ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott endorsed the acquisition, highlighting its strategic importance for accelerating business transformation.

title: ServiceNow and AWS Expand Strategic Collaboration With New Capabilities to Accelerate AI Transformation
summary: ServiceNow and Amazon Web Services (AWS) have announced an expanded strategic collaboration to accelerate AI-driven business transformation. This includes a new connector for seamlessly using multimodal models from Amazon Bedrock with GenAI-powered workflows on the Now Platform, and additional automation solutions now available in the AWS Marketplace. The collaboration aims to provide integrated, end-to-end solutions, with geographical expansion to Canada and Europe expected in 2025.

title: Netflix doubles down on its ‘big bet on live’ events with huge deal to air NFL Christmas Day games
summary: Netflix has secured a three-season deal to air National Football League games on Christmas Day, marking a significant expansion into live sports. The agreement, valued at about $150 million for the first two games this year, is part of Netflix's strategy to attract massive audiences and boost advertising revenue through live programming. This move builds on Netflix's previous experiments with live events and its existing relationship with the NFL through documentary series.

title: Amazon Prime Big Deal Days 2024: What to know about the sales event and preview of deals
summary: Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days 2024 event is scheduled for October 8-9, offering significant discounts across various product categories for Prime members. Early deals are already available, and additional bargains will drop frequently during the two-day sales event. Shoppers can expect savings on major brands in toys, electronics, beauty, clothing, and more.

title: Home and Small Business Security System Market Report 2024 - Professionally Monitored Alarm Systems in Europe and North America Reached 55 Million in 2023 - ResearchAndMarkets.com
summary: The "Home and Small Business Security System Market - 14th Edition" report by ResearchAndMarkets.com indicates that professionally monitored alarm systems in Europe and North America reached 55 million in 2023. North America leads with 36 million active systems and a 23.2% penetration rate, projected to grow to 42.9 million by 2028. Europe, with 19 million systems and a 7.6% penetration, shows significant growth potential, particularly in the residential segment.

title: Alibaba to sell Sun Art shares for $1.69 billion
summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd announced its decision to sell all of its shares in hypermarket operator Sun Art Retail Group Ltd to private equity firm DCP Capital for HK$13.13 billion ($1.69 billion). This move allows Alibaba to focus on its core e-commerce business. Following the completion of the deal, Alibaba will no longer hold any equity interest in Sun Art.

title: Amazon Accused of Mismanaging Millions of 401(k) Forfeiture Funds
summary: Amazon.com Inc. and its 401(k) plan administrative committee are facing a lawsuit for allegedly mismanaging millions in employee forfeiture funds. A participant, Cory Curtis, claims that Amazon used these funds to offset its own contributions rather than reducing administrative fees for plan participants between 2018 and 2023. The lawsuit highlights a growing trend of forfeiture-related litigation against large companies, although critics argue that such cases weaponize ERISA given Amazon's already low plan fees.

title: Tech Stocks Are Still Pricey. Dip Buyers Should Look Here Instead.
summary: Investors seeking "buy-the-dip" opportunities might be advised to look beyond tech stocks, which remain expensive despite recent market fluctuations. Instead, the article suggests considering other sectors, highlighting that the Industrial Select Sector SPDR Fund has seen a significant drop from its recent high. This implies that industrial stocks may present a more attractive dip-buying opportunity than pricey tech stocks.

title: Georgia Power warns customers to be ‘vigilant of scams’ in the new year
summary: Georgia Power is warning its customers to be vigilant against various scams, especially around the new year and tax season when scam attempts typically increase. The company highlighted tech scams involving unauthorized payment apps like Cash App and fake digital ads leading to fraudulent websites designed to steal personal or financial information. Georgia Power emphasized that it will never demand immediate payment via credit card, pre-paid debit card, cryptocurrency, or money transfer apps over the phone, nor collect payments in person outside of authorized locations.

title: eBay Loses Motors Events Manager, NASCAR Driver Sarah Burgess To Walmart In Race For Enthusiast Buyers
summary: Walmart continues its strategy of challenging eBay in key focus categories by attracting talent, with Sarah Burgess, eBay's Sr Partnership US Motors Events Manager and NASCAR driver, moving to Walmart Marketplace. Burgess will take on a Senior Management Business Development role in Parts and Accessories, a critical category for eBay. This move highlights Walmart's aggressive push into enthusiast buyer verticals, including collectibles and pre-owned goods, often by hiring former eBay executives.

title: Cybersecurity pioneer, tech CEO Amit Yoran dies 'unexpectedly' amid cancer battle
summary: Amit Yoran, the CEO of Tenable Holdings and a prominent figure in cybersecurity, has died unexpectedly at 54 after a battle with cancer. Yoran was a visionary leader, having also founded the U.S. Computer Emergency Readiness Team (US-CERT) program at the Department of Homeland Security. His leadership transformed Tenable into a global leader in exposure management, and his contributions to the cybersecurity field are described as indelible.

title: Schwab Trading Activity Index™: December Score Edges Higher for Third Consecutive Month
summary: The Schwab Trading Activity Index™ (STAX) increased to 51.16 in December, marking its third consecutive monthly rise. Schwab clients net bought equities, adding exposure in Health Care and Energy sectors, while selling Information Technology and Communication Services. The report highlights market volatility, key economic data releases, and popular stocks bought and sold by Schwab clients throughout December and the entirety of 2024.

title: How Akamai regained control of its runaway cloud bills
summary: Akamai, a technology company, significantly reduced its cloud spending by 40% in the first year of "Project Cirrus" after realizing its cloud bills had ballooned to hundreds of millions due to organic growth and acquisitions. The project involved repatriating some workloads to Akamai's acquired Linode cloud platform, reconfiguring others, and addressing inefficiencies like overprovisioning and a lack of oversight. Akamai's CIO, Kate Prouty, emphasized the importance of a strategic overhaul, educating engineers on cost stewardship, and making more deliberate choices for cloud workloads based on business outcomes.

title: Selling Covered Calls: How to Do It
summary: Selling covered calls is an options trading strategy where investors sell call options on stocks they already own to generate income. This conservative technique involves receiving a premium, but it carries the risk of limiting potential upside if the stock price significantly increases above the strike price. The article explains the mechanics, pros, and cons of covered calls, differentiating them from riskier "naked calls" and exploring covered call ETFs as an alternative.

title: Carbon6 to be acquired by US-based SPS Commerce for $301 million CAD to grow e-commerce merchant toolkit
summary: Toronto-based e-commerce software aggregator Carbon6 Technologies is being acquired by Minneapolis-based SPS Commerce for $301 million CAD ($210 million USD), with the transaction expected to close in Q1 2025. Carbon6's model involved acquiring numerous companies to build an all-in-one platform for Amazon merchants, and SPS Commerce believes the acquisition will expand its network and revenue recovery capabilities. The deal will bring an additional $40 million in revenue for SPS Commerce in 2025 and grow its adjusted EBITDA by approximately $5.5 million.

title: Ambiq and ThinkAR Disrupt the AR Glasses Industry with the AiLens
summary: Ambiq and ThinkAR have partnered to launch AiLens, a lightweight pair of smart AR glasses designed for everyday wear. These glasses weigh only 37 grams, offer over 10 hours of battery life, and are powered by Ambiq's ultra-efficient Apollo4 System-on-Chip (SoC) and ThinkAR's advanced AI capabilities. AiLens aims to redefine the AR glasses market with features like an AI-powered personal assistant, real-time language translation, and seamless integration with various platforms.

title: BBVA Accelerates Banking Innovation with AWS Cloud Migration
summary: BBVA has successfully migrated its data platform to Amazon Web Services (AWS) across its European operations, significantly reducing analytics task times by 94%. This move enhances BBVA's data storage, processing capabilities, and security, with plans to expand the ADA platform to Latin American markets by 2025. The strategic partnership with AWS aims to leverage advanced analytics, AI, and machine learning to drive technological innovation and improve customer services globally.

title: JPMorgan Chase reportedly joins the 5-days-a-week RTO wave
summary: J.P. Morgan Chase & Co. is reportedly joining Goldman Sachs in requiring employees to work from the office five days a week, hinting at a potential new norm for financial services firms. CEO Jamie Dimon has been a strong proponent of in-person work, stating that "In general, there's nothing like face-to-face." This move comes despite warnings from some experts about potential employee dissatisfaction and signaling employer mistrust regarding all-or-nothing work arrangements.

title: EXEC: Hydro Flask Adds Velocity with Expanding Amazon, Target and Costco Programs
summary: Helen of Troy Limited, parent company of Hydro Flask, Osprey, and OXO brands, reported positive momentum in its Home & Outdoor segment for Q3 fiscal year 2025, partially offsetting declines in Beauty & Wellness. Hydro Flask saw significant distribution gains at Target and Costco, alongside strong e-commerce performance, including being Amazon's #1 Best Seller during Prime Day. The company also detailed its Project Pegasus restructuring plan, aimed at improving operating margins, and provided an updated fiscal 2025 outlook including the acquisition of Olive & June.

title: News | Albertsons steps up streamlining of stores, including closings
summary: Albertsons is moving forward with streamlining its store portfolio, which will include both opening and closing locations, after its proposed merger with Kroger was blocked. The company aims to cut $1.5 billion in costs over the next three years and will focus on optimizing its real estate footprint. While there may be more closures than previously seen due to "general hygiene of the real estate portfolio," Albertsons also plans for new store openings and will consider strategic transactions to create long-term shareholder value.

title: Lumen’s Finke Charts Network, AI Intersections
summary: Josh Finke, Lumen's Senior Vice President, Public Sector, discusses how Lumen Technologies is supporting Federal government agencies with network modernization and AI integration. The company is focusing on simplifying technology consumption, enhancing network security and reliability, and building an "AI fabric" to support data-intensive AI workloads. Finke also shared Lumen's perspective on Federal AI policy, emphasizing a multi-phase approach to AI adoption for measurable outcomes.

title: Israeli companies Teva, Wix listed as 2025 top stock picks by analysts
summary: US analysts have identified two Israeli companies, Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. and Wix.com Ltd., as top stock picks for 2025. Bank of America raised its price target for Teva, citing its stabilizing financial profile and strong product pipeline, while Cantor Fitzgerald selected Wix, highlighting its product roadmap, pricing strength, and potential as an acquisition target. Both companies saw significant stock price increases in 2024.

title: Macy's closing 66 stores, including four in Michigan
summary: Macy's Inc. announced it will close 66 underperforming stores as part of its "Bold New Chapter" strategy, aiming for sustainable growth. Four Michigan locations, including those in Traverse City, Sterling Heights, Troy, and Flint, are among the closures. This move reflects a broader trend of declining department store interest and increased online shopping, according to retail experts.

title: JPMorgan tells staff to return to the office five days a week
summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. has mandated that all employees return to the office five days a week starting in March, ending its hybrid work policy. While some locations currently lack the capacity, the bank aims to accommodate all employees, confirming feasibility by the end of the month. This move aligns JPMorgan with other major companies like Amazon and Walmart, despite acknowledging that not all employees will agree with the decision.

title: 美 장기채 ETF, 미워도 다시 한번…테슬라·아이온큐도 '베팅'
summary: 국내 상위 1% 투자자들이 미 장기채 ETF인 '디렉시온 데일리 만기 20년 이상 미국 국채 3X(TMF)'를 집중적으로 순매수하고 있다. 이들은 미 중앙은행의 금리 인하 속도 조절 가능성에도 불구하고 현재 금리 수준을 고점으로 판단하고 있으며, 테슬라와 아이온큐 역시 도널드 트럼프 당선인의 영향력 확대 기대감에 힘입어 고수들의 순매수 종목에 올랐다. 반면, 레버리지 상품인 '디렉시온 데일리 테슬라 불 2X 셰어즈(TSLL)'와 팰런티어, 그리고 '매그니피센트 7' 일부 종목은 순매도세를 보였다.

title: Why a serial entrepreneur shops at Trader Joe’s, eschews a wristwatch, and believes the future of office work is in your computer
summary: Howard Lerman, a serial entrepreneur and founder of Yext and Roam, shares insights into his "Good Life" and approach to work. He discusses his investment strategies, daily habits, and vision for the future of office work through his virtual office platform, Roam. Lerman emphasizes efficiency, a structured personal style, and continuous learning, while also revealing some of his luxury indulgences and travel experiences.

title: Advance Auto Parts taps former Dollar General exec as CTO
summary: Advance Auto Parts has appointed Shweta Bhatia, formerly SVP of technology at Dollar General, as its new EVP and CTO. Bhatia brings 20 years of retail technology experience, including stints at Walmart and Kohl's, and will replace Sri Donthi. Her appointment comes as Advance Auto Parts implements a turnaround plan involving store closures, cost cutting, and supply chain optimization, aiming to leverage her IT modernization expertise from Dollar General.

title: Liberty All-Star Growth Fund Reports -3.94% December Drop, But 15.53% YTD Gain
summary: Liberty All-Star Growth Fund (ASG) reported a -3.94% NAV and -3.75% market price performance for December 2024, despite ending the year with strong year-to-date gains of 15.53% (NAV) and 16.53% (market price). The fund's portfolio, with 97.7% invested in equities, was concentrated in Information Technology (29.5%), Health Care (16.8%), and Industrials (16.8%), holding top positions in NVIDIA, Apple, and Amazon. The fund executed significant portfolio adjustments in December and traded at a -7.4% discount to its NAV.

title: Why Have Dividend Stock Strategies Been Underperforming?
summary: Dividend stock strategies significantly underperformed the broader market in 2024, with the Morningstar Dividend Composite Index rising 15.7% compared to the Morningstar US Market Index's 24.1% gain. This underperformance is primarily attributed to the low exposure to technology stocks within dividend strategies, as tech and communication services were the best-performing sectors. Additionally, many top market contributors like Nvidia, Apple, and Amazon have low or no dividend payouts, favoring share repurchases as a way to return cash to shareholders, which dividend indexes typically do not capture.

title: What’s new with Matter: how Matter 1.4 is reshaping interoperability and energy management
summary: Matter 1.4 is the latest update to the smart home interoperability standard, introducing support for new device types like solar panels, heat pumps, and water heaters, alongside enhanced energy management features. This update also streamlines the multi-admin experience, allowing users to connect devices to several smart home systems more efficiently. While adoption is gradual, Matter 1.4 further solidifies the protocol's goal of creating a unified and user-friendly smart home ecosystem.

title: Premier Protein® Launches NEW Line of Indulgent High Protein Shakes
summary: Premier Protein has launched a new line of "Indulgence" high protein shakes, offering four dessert-inspired flavors: Decadent Dark Chocolate, Salted Caramel Truffle, Chocolate Covered Strawberry, and White Chocolate Raspberry. Each shake contains 30g of protein, 3g of sugar, and 170 calories, aiming to satisfy sweet cravings while supporting health and wellness goals. The new shakes are available at Walmart and Amazon, with more information on premierprotein.com.

title: Energy Vault Shares Rise On NuCube Partnership For Modular Nuclear Reactors: Retail Applauds Carbon-Free Energy Push
summary: Energy Vault Holdings Inc. (NRGV) saw its stock jump over 9% following an announcement of a partnership with NuCube Energy. This collaboration aims to accelerate the deployment of NuCube’s small, modular microreactor, NuSun, designed to power industrial and data-center applications, by late 2028 or early 2029. Energy Vault will contribute expertise in material science and integrate its VaultOS platform to manage energy storage and the NuSun hardware, addressing the growing demand for sustainable and reliable energy solutions for hyperscalers.

title: AI revolution: Impact Series
summary: The article discusses the significant infrastructure demands of the AI revolution, highlighting the strain on resources like power, land, water, and materials due to increasing AI adoption and model training. It emphasizes the need for responsible and sustainable development of AI, examining energy consumption by data centers and the growing demand for "firm" and "dispatchable" power sources like nuclear and geothermal energy. Authors Christian Keller, William Thompson, and Akash Utsav contributed to this Impact Series report from Barclays Research, stressing the global challenge of balancing economic opportunities with environmental sustainability in AI development.

title: Milka chocolate sold in Canada recalled for containing undeclared nuts
summary: Milka chocolate bars, specifically the Bubbly Alpine Milk product, have been recalled across Canada due to undeclared hazelnuts, posing a risk to those with allergies. The Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA) issued the recall, noting the product was distributed in several provinces and sold online. Mondelez International, owner of Milka, stated the product was not authorized for sale in Canada by their Canadian entity and attributed the issue to an incorrect label applied by an unauthorized distributor.

title: Biden Administration Releases Executive Order on AI Infrastructure
summary: The Biden Administration issued an Executive Order on AI Infrastructure on January 14, 2025, aimed at advancing U.S. leadership in AI, preventing reliance on foreign infrastructure, and promoting clean energy for AI operations. The EO directs federal agencies to lease federal land for private-sector construction of "frontier AI infrastructure," including data centers and clean energy facilities, by specified timelines. It also outlines requirements for expedited permitting and upgrades to electricity grid infrastructure to support these AI developments.

title: IMAX Secures Netflix Deal for Exclusive 'Narnia' Theatrical Release, Stock Jumps
summary: IMAX has announced a deal with Netflix to exclusively release Greta Gerwig's "Narnia" film across its global theater network for two weeks starting Thanksgiving 2026, before it premieres on Netflix at Christmas 2026. This move, which caused IMAX stock to jump, marks a rare theatrical-first strategy for Netflix, known for premiering films directly on its platform. The collaboration follows Netflix's previous efforts to attract subscribers through premium sports content and its crackdown on password sharing.

title: MicroStrategy Sets Sights on Amazon and Alphabet’s Common Shares Dominance
summary: MicroStrategy is seeking shareholder approval to dramatically increase its authorized Class A common shares from 330 million to 10.3 billion, a move that would position it with more shares outstanding than many Nasdaq 100 tech giants. This expansion is designed to fuel its aggressive Bitcoin acquisition strategy, which has already seen its stock surge over 2,500% since 2020. Despite potential dilution concerns, investors appear to prioritize the company's Bitcoin-centric growth.

title: Our favorite Corsair gaming headset is now down to its best price
summary: The Corsair Virtuoso Pro gaming headset, a PCWorld Editors’ Choice award recipient, is currently available on Amazon for $140, a 30% reduction from its original price. Reviewers praised its high-quality design, excellent sound, and detachable microphone, making it suitable for both gaming and general use. This deal represents the best price for this highly-rated wired headset.

title: Amazon Adds Teladoc Health to Health Benefits Program
summary: Amazon has expanded its Health Benefits Connector by adding Teladoc Health for cardiometabolic support. This program links Amazon customers to digital health companies offering various services, with Amazon promoting Teladoc Health's services for diabetes, hypertension, pre-diabetes, and weight management. While this partnership offers a new access point for Teladoc Health's services, the company remains cautious about its immediate revenue impact.

title: Top ETFs That Beat the Market in 2024 and Could Do It Again
summary: In 2024, ETFs experienced record inflows, with investors contributing $1.1 trillion. This article highlights three traditional ETFs that significantly outperformed the broader market in 2024: the Invesco S&P 500 Momentum ETF (SPMO), the American Century Focused Dynamic Growth ETF (FDG), and the Hartford Large Cap Growth ETF (HFGO). These funds, which delivered returns ranging from 41.7% to 47.3%, are identified as strong contenders to continue their momentum into 2025.

title: 3 Fidelity ETFs You Can Buy and Hold Forever to Generate $100,000 in Yearly Dividend Income, Starting in 2025
summary: This article examines three Fidelity ETFs that could generate significant dividend income. It details the Fidelity International Value Factor ETF (FIVA), the Fidelity International High Dividend ETF (FIDI), and the Fidelity Yield Enhanced Equity ETF (FYEE), outlining their dividend yields, expense ratios, holdings, and potential risks. The piece calculates the approximate investment needed in each ETF to achieve $100,000 in annual dividend income.

title: Spotify: Strong Growth, Improving Profits Make It A Great Long-Term Buy (NYSE:SPOT)
summary: Spotify is showing strong profitable growth, marked by record-high gross margins, solid cash flow, and strategic expansions into various audio content. Despite a high Price-to-Sales ratio, its rapid revenue growth, improved profitability, and free cash flow justify its premium valuation. Key drivers include increased ad revenue, international market expansion, and advanced ad-targeting tools, though risks like licensing costs, competition, and regulatory scrutiny remain.

title: Top 100 Healthcare IT Consultant Project Areas in Highest Demand: Leading Advisory Firms Driving the Future of Healthcare Innovation
summary: Black Book Research has identified the top 100 healthcare IT advisory services projected to be in highest demand for 2025, based on over 5,100 engagements and insights from 900 healthcare sector respondents. The analysis, which evaluated firms on six Key Performance Indicators including business impact, regulatory compliance, and client satisfaction, highlights critical project areas like cybersecurity, EHR optimization, and AI strategies. Leading advisory firms such as Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, and Huron Consulting Group are recognized for driving innovation and delivering significant impact across these key domains.

title: Oracle Named a Leader in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Cloud Database Management Systems
summary: Oracle has been recognized as a Leader in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Cloud Database Management Systems, highlighting its converged database architecture and continuous innovation. The company's database services, including Oracle Autonomous Database and Oracle Database 23ai, offer flexible intercloud and multicloud deployment choices, enabling customers to leverage various data and application development models for enterprise data and AI workloads. Oracle Database is lauded for its rapid pace of innovation and industry-leading multicloud capabilities, now available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

title: Sonos takeover speculation grows, with Spotify or Amazon tipped as potential suitors (report)
summary: Speculation is mounting that audio technology company Sonos could be acquired following a problematic app rollout in 2024 and recent leadership changes, including the departure of CEO Patrick Spence. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman identifies Spotify and Amazon as the most likely suitors. While Amazon could integrate Sonos' premium audio into its Echo devices, Spotify could gain immediate entry into the hardware market, despite its past struggles with products like the "Car Thing."

title: As Netflix stock surges, an ‘anti-ESPN’ sports strategy emerges
summary: Netflix's stock is surging due to its "anti-ESPN" sports strategy, focusing on high-profile, "can't-miss" special events rather than regular-season packages. The company's successful Christmas Day NFL games and Paul-Tyson boxing match significantly boosted subscriber numbers. With its substantial market cap and global audience, Netflix can strategically acquire premium sports rights like the Women's World Cup, potentially leading to future UFC or Men's World Cup deals, challenging traditional sports broadcasters.

title: IUSV: A Cost-Effective Value ETF With Strong Downside Protection And Growth Potential

These innovations aim to enable 800Gb/s and 1.6Tb/s optical interconnects with improved power efficiency, with mass production planned for its facility in Crolles, France. The company is collaborating with partners like Amazon Web Services (AWS) to refine its PIC100 silicon photonics platform, positioning itself in a market projected to grow significantly, with silicon photonics anticipated to account for 60% of the optical transceiver market by 2030.

title: 19 Affiliate Marketing Tools to Boost Conversions
summary: This article lists 19 essential affiliate marketing tools to help boost conversions, covering various aspects like SEO, social media management, email marketing, and content creation. Each tool is described with its features, pricing, pros, and cons. The article also provides best practices for choosing and leveraging these tools effectively, emphasizing goal setting, avoiding overlap, and consistency.

title: Dividend Aristocrats In Focus: Walmart Inc.
summary: Walmart Inc. is highlighted as a Dividend Aristocrat and King, having increased its dividend for 52 consecutive years. The company has shown strong growth, particularly in e-commerce, and demonstrated resilience during recessions due to its massive scale and low-cost strategy. Despite its strong performance and strategic investments, the stock is currently considered overvalued, leading to a "hold" rating based on its price-to-earnings ratio and projected total returns.

title: Alphabet’s chief accounting officer sells $238k in stock
summary: Alphabet's Chief Accounting Officer, Amie Thuener O’Toole, sold 1,374 shares of Class C Capital Stock totaling approximately $238,347. This transaction was part of a Rule 10b5-1 Trading Plan. Alphabet maintains strong financial health, with robust cash flows and recent updates in personalized ads policy, AI development, and office attendance requirements for employees.

title: First Class Action Filed Under Washington’s MY Health MY Data Act Draws Parallels to Previous SDK Litigation
summary: The first class action lawsuit under Washington's MY Health MY Data Act (MHMDA) has been filed against Amazon, alleging improper collection and use of consumer location data via Software Development Kits (SDKs). The lawsuit, Maxwell v. Amazon.com, Inc., draws parallels to prior SDK class actions, but introduces MHMDA's broad private right of action for violations related to "consumer health data," which includes precise location information. Businesses are advised to be mindful of SDK use as more states enact privacy legislation and similar lawsuits are expected.

title: AutoZone's Profit Shrinks and Misses Estimates Despite Rising Sales
summary: AutoZone (AZO) reported a year-over-year decline in fiscal second-quarter profit, missing analyst expectations despite an increase in net sales. Net income fell by 5.3% to $487.92 million, or $28.29 per share, while net sales grew by 2% to $3.95 billion, slightly below consensus. The profit decrease was largely attributed to a 6% increase in operating and SG&A expenses and negative foreign currency impacts on international same-store sales.

title: Millennial CEO of Kraft Heinz's most recent acquisition has a hack for being present in meetings—an old-fashioned pink notebook
summary: Verena Zander, the millennial CEO of Just Spices, a Kraft Heinz acquisition, shares her "Good Life" with Fortune, detailing her personal finance habits and work-life balance. Despite the availability of AI tools, Zander prefers an old-fashioned pink notebook for note-taking in meetings, believing it fosters better presence and memory retention. The article also touches on the growth of Just Spices under her leadership and offers insights into her daily routines and investment choices.

title: Kornit Apollo for American Classics Apparel
summary: American Classics Apparel, a major wholesaler of licensed music, film, and gaming apparel, has adopted the Kornit Apollo platform to transition from traditional screen printing to high-speed digital production. This move is aimed at meeting increasing customer demand and leveraging the expanding e-tailer marketplace. The integration of Kornit Apollo will enhance the company's speed, efficiency, and quality in delivering licensed apparel.

title: Pardon the Disruption: Where does Kroger go from here?
summary: Rodney McMullen's unexpected resignation as Kroger CEO leaves the supermarket giant facing significant challenges, including stiff competition from discounters, an uncertain omnichannel strategy, and the failed Albertsons merger. The new CEO will need to innovate and revitalize Kroger's core grocery business, digital presence, and explore further acquisitions to maintain relevance in a rapidly evolving market. Despite its strengths in private label and alternative profit streams, Kroger must adapt to customer demands and differentiate itself beyond traditional supermarket advantages.

title: Philips just launched its first Roku OLED TV and it looks like a steal for PS5 owners
summary: Philips has introduced its first Roku OLED TV, the 65-inch Class 974 Series, which offers a 4K 120Hz refresh rate for $1,299. This model is presented as a cost-effective option for PS5 owners, providing premium gaming features at a lower price point than comparable LG or Sony OLED TVs, though it is currently exclusive to Sam's Club members. The TV includes Dolby Vision IQ, HDR10, Dolby Atmos, and AMD FreeSync Premium, making it a strong contender in the gaming TV market.

title: CISO Global Continues to Advance AI-Powered Security Solutions within Microsoft and Amazon Cloud
summary: CISO Global is advancing its AI-powered security solutions within Microsoft Azure and Amazon AWS ecosystems. The company successfully developed a Proof of Concept for integrating its Argo Secure platform with Microsoft Security Copilot, enhancing asset management and threat detection. Additionally, CISO Global's TIGRIS GRC solution is now available on the AWS Marketplace, offering cloud-based security assessment and compliance tools.

title: Armlogi Holding Corp. Announces Letter of Intent to Acquire Leopard Transnational Inc.
summary: Armlogi Holding Corp. (Nasdaq: BTOC) has announced a non-binding Letter of Intent to acquire Leopard Transnational Inc., a California-based logistics provider. This strategic acquisition aims to expand Armlogi's warehousing footprint by 360,000 square feet and enhance its e-commerce fulfillment capabilities, particularly benefiting cross-border e-commerce sellers and major online marketplaces. The deal, which involves Armlogi common stock and potential earn-out payments, is expected to be finalized within 60-90 days, pending due diligence and necessary approvals.

title: What Is Direct Indexing?
summary: Direct indexing allows investors to own the individual stocks within an index directly, offering benefits like tax-loss harvesting and customizability for ESG or other preferences. However, it is most suitable for those with substantial taxable investments due to potential complexities, higher fees, and the risks associated with active management and tracking error. The strategy can enhance tax efficiency and align portfolios with personal values but requires significant oversight and may not always outperform traditional index funds.

title: Polar announces new AI-ready data center powered by 100 percent renewable energy in Norway
summary: Polar has announced the construction of a new multi-phase, AI-ready data center in Tørdal, Norway, powered entirely by renewable hydroelectric energy. The first phase, DRA01, will provide 12MW of capacity and is expected to be operational in the second half of 2025, addressing the increasing demand for AI computing infrastructure in Europe. The facility leverages Norway's natural resources for energy efficiency and features advanced liquid cooling and high-density rack configurations optimized for AI applications.

title: Salesforce joins growing list of companies ending diversity hiring initiatives
summary: Salesforce Inc. has become the latest company to end its diversity hiring initiatives, removing language about diversity and inclusion from its annual financial disclosure. This decision follows executive orders signed by President Donald Trump targeting the elimination of DEI programs. Other major companies like Google, Meta, Target, Amazon, Walmart, and Deloitte have also rolled back similar initiatives.

title: Why Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd (CRDO) Went Down on Wednesday
summary: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd (CRDO) stock fell by 13.97 percent on Wednesday despite reporting impressive third-quarter fiscal year 2025 earnings. The decline is attributed to investors having already factored in higher income due to the company's growth in AI infrastructure and strong customer base, including Amazon, Tesla, and Microsoft. While CRDO posted significant increases in net income and revenues, it was among the worst performers for the day, suggesting that some AI stocks may offer more promising returns.

title: Arlo Essential XL Outdoor Security Camera, Tested: The Best Overall Model You Can Buy
summary: This article reviews the Arlo Essential XL Outdoor Security Camera, highlighting its impressive battery life, ease of setup, and solid performance without requiring a monthly subscription for basic features. Priced at $150, it offers 2K resolution, color night vision, and an integrated spotlight, setting it apart from competitors. While advanced features necessitate a subscription, the camera's core functionality makes it a top recommendation for both renters and homeowners.

title: Legislature takes up plan to shield Oregon consumers from data centers’ power costs
summary: Oregon lawmakers are considering House Bill 3546 to protect residential consumers from the rising costs of powering data centers. The bill would classify data centers and cryptocurrency miners as a new utility customer class, giving regulators authority to ensure households and small businesses don't shoulder these costs, and requiring new high-load customers to sign 10-year power purchase contracts. While some tech companies like Google support the idea of multi-year agreements and infrastructure charges, they suggest expanding the bill to cover all large power loads, not just data centers, and including collateral requirements.

title: Grayscale Investments LLC Grayscale Zcash Trust (ZEC) (ZCSH) reports earnings
summary: Grayscale Investments LLC Grayscale Zcash Trust (ZEC) (ZCSH) has filed its annual 10-K report for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. The Trust aims to track the value of ZEC, holding approximately 2.4% of ZEC in circulation as of year-end, and the report details its operations, risks associated with digital assets, and the role of Grayscale Investments LLC as the Sponsor.

title: Defined Outcome ETFs: Good For Conservative Investors, Not Necessarily Conservative Investments
summary: Defined Outcome ETFs utilize options to provide a buffer against downside risk while capping potential upside, making them appealing to conservative investors. This article argues that these strategies are particularly effective when applied to volatile markets like China's internet sector, where they can offer higher upside potential compared to similar strategies for more stable assets such as the S&P 500 Index. The KraneShares 100% KWEB Defined Outcome January 2027 ETF (KPRO) and the KraneShares 90% KWEB Defined Outcome January 2027 ETF (KBUF) are highlighted as examples that apply this strategy to the volatile but high-growth China internet sector.

title: The Friday Checkout: Exits of Kroger and Albertsons chiefs tell a tale of two grocers
summary: The CEOs of Kroger and Albertsons, Rodney McMullen and Vivek Sankaran, have both departed their companies after their attempted merger failed due to regulatory issues. Kroger, under new leadership, is projecting growth and investing in new stores, while Albertsons is implementing aggressive cost-cutting measures, including store closures and layoffs, as it seeks stability with a new CEO. This column also covers other grocery industry news, including Uber Eats' partnership with FreshDirect, Arkansas's proposed grocery tax elimination, Kroger's foot traffic data, and Aldi's new fan gear for kids.

title: Downtown Seattle mainstay closing soon
summary: The Cheesecake Factory's downtown Seattle location, operating for over two decades, will close on May 4 due to an extensive company review. This closure, along with other national brands departing, signifies another challenge for downtown Seattle's revitalization efforts following the pandemic. Despite some new developments and recommitments, the area continues to face setbacks in commercial activity.

title: The Case for Costco Stock Hitting $1,000 in the Next Year
summary: Costco (COST) stock has significantly outperformed the broader market, even with its high valuation and a recent dip from an all-time high of $1,078.23. Analysts are optimistic about its future, with one setting a price target of $1,205, driven by the company's strong business model, loyal customer base, and investments in e-commerce and recent membership fee hikes. While there are concerns about its high P/E ratio, its consistent growth and strong earnings performance are seen as justifying its premium.

title: After Earnings, Is Salesforce Stock a Buy, a Sell, or Fairly Valued?
summary: Salesforce CRM recently released its fourth-quarter earnings, showing results generally in line with expectations, supported by healthy multi-cloud deals and an expanding AI platform. Morningstar maintains a fair value estimate of $315.00 per share, rating the stock as ★★★ (fairly valued) with a wide economic moat and high uncertainty. The company's financial strength is considered sound, with a solid net cash position and growing margins, despite risks related to leadership and revenue growth deceleration in certain segments.

title: Congressman Ditches Russell 2000 ETF To Buy Lithium, Uranium ETFs
summary: Senator John Boozman (R-Ark.) recently sold his position in a Russell 2000 ETF and purchased Sprott Lithium Miners ETF and Sprott Uranium Miners ETF. This move suggests a belief that these commodities may outperform the broader stock market. Boozman has shown previous interest in Arkansas' lithium production and the U.S.'s role in energy independence, potentially influenced by trade policies.

title: News | Tech CEO follows his customers in relocating to South Florida
summary: Varonis, a technology company, is relocating its headquarters from New York to Miami, following a trend of businesses moving to South Florida. Co-founder and CEO Yaki Faitelson cited Miami's business-friendly environment, quality of life, and ability to attract talent and clients as key factors. The move reflects Miami's growing appeal as a hub for finance, tech, and professional services, though the local office market is currently experiencing a moderation after a pandemic-era boom.

title: Coinbase to Debut Combined Equities & Crypto Index Futures
summary: Coinbase Derivatives is set to launch Mag7 + Crypto Equity Index Futures on September 22, offering the first US-listed derivative that provides combined exposure to traditional equities and cryptocurrency ETFs. This innovative product aims to provide thematic exposure to innovation and growth assets, diversification, and strategic risk management. The index will include the "Magnificent 7" stocks (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA, META, TSLA), Coinbase Global Inc. (COIN), and cryptocurrency ETFs (IBIT, ETHA), with an even-weighting methodology and quarterly rebalancing.

title: Netgear Orbi 870 Wi-Fi 7 mesh router review: Solid performance can’t mask high price and feature regression
summary: The Netgear Orbi 870 Wi-Fi 7 mesh router delivers solid wireless performance across 6 GHz and 5 GHz bands but falls short on features compared to competitors and its more expensive sibling, the Orbi 970. Despite its high price of $1,299 for a three-node system, it lacks 5 Gbps or 10 Gbps LAN ports and USB connectivity, which are available on similarly priced or even cheaper alternatives. Reviewer Brandon Hill criticizes the Orbi 870's value proposition, suggesting that other mesh systems offer comparable performance with better hardware and software capabilities for the same or less cost.

title: Whole Foods at The Shops at Sun Vet to open earlier than planned, developer says
summary: The Shops at SunVet in Holbrook, formerly Sun Vet Mall, is over 70% leased and on track for completion this year, with Whole Foods Market opening earlier than expected in fall 2025 instead of spring 2026. This $93 million redevelopment by Regency Centers Corp. is transforming the struggling 1970s mall into an upscale open-air shopping center with tenants like Nordstrom Rack, Shake Shack, and Sephora. Mild winter weather allowed for accelerated construction, contributing to the earlier opening of Whole Foods.

title: ARM & HAMMER™ Laundry and Meghan Trainor Hit All the Right Notes with the 'Toss Like This' Laundry ‘Re-Trainor’ Campaign!
summary: ARM & HAMMER Laundry has partnered with GRAMMY® winning artist Meghan Trainor for a campaign called “Toss Like This,” aimed at simplifying laundry routines with ARM & HAMMER POWER SHEETS™ Laundry Detergent. Trainor transforms her hit song into a playful jingle to highlight the convenience and eco-friendliness of the new detergent sheets, which eliminate bulky plastic bottles and offer powerful cleaning. The POWER SHEETS are available on Amazon and Walmart, packaged in recyclable cartons and designed for easy use at home or on the go.

title: Arkansas Faces Surge in Power Demand from AI & Data Centers
summary: Arkansas and national utility leaders are preparing for a significant increase in electricity demand driven by AI hubs, data centers, and other power-intensive industries. This surge could lead to higher electricity bills but also presents an opportunity for economic development, with utilities seeking legislation to finance new power plants and attract large projects like Elon Musk's xAI data center. The article highlights the scale of this projected demand growth, with Arkansas Electric Cooperative Corp. already evaluating requests for 4,000 megawatts of additional load, and utility companies like AECC and Entergy Arkansas are planning new natural gas-fired generation plants to meet future needs and replace retiring coal plants.

title: Exclusive: How NetApp is navigating the fourth wave of technology with AI-driven data infrastructure
summary: NetApp's Chief Technology Evangelist, Matt Watts, discusses how the company is adapting to the "fourth wave" of technology driven by intelligent data infrastructure and AI, learning from past technological shifts like virtualization and cloud adoption. The article highlights NetApp's unified storage and intelligent services as key solutions for AI integration, addressing challenges such as data silos and security, while also predicting quantum computing as the potential "fifth wave." Watts emphasizes the importance of letting go of outdated systems and embracing change to stay innovative.

title: Palantir (NASDAQ:PLTR) Extends Collapse as Tech Stock Carnage Exposes Giant Valuation Gap
summary: Palantir (PLTR) stock has experienced a significant collapse, losing over a third of its market cap in three weeks, despite its upcoming inclusion in the S&P 100. This downturn is attributed to a broader tech stock selloff, concerns over potential defense spending cuts by the U.S. government—a major client for Palantir—and the exposure of previously lofty valuations in the tech sector. Analysts currently rate PLTR as a Hold, with an average price target suggesting a 20% upside.

title: Ulta Beauty’s new CMO on balancing cultural pizzazz with socially minded initiatives
summary: Ulta Beauty's new CMO, Kelly Mahoney, discusses the brand's strategy of blending high-profile cultural marketing, such as Super Bowl and Golden Globes sponsorships, with a continued commitment to DEI initiatives and customer accessibility. Mahoney emphasizes the importance of authentic social media engagement and the strategic balance required to navigate economic uncertainties like tariffs while maintaining brand relevance and purpose.

title: Vodafone: Be in the office 8 days a month or lose bonuses
summary: Vodafone is mandating its UK employees to work in the office at least eight days a month, or face disciplinary action and potential loss of bonuses starting April 1. This policy, in place since 2021, is now being strictly enforced, despite staff concerns about reduced office space and the need to collaborate with remote international teams via video calls. The company emphasizes the importance of in-office collaboration while employees point to research questioning the productivity benefits of RTO mandates and the impact on morale.

title: Why FCF ETF 'VFLO' Looks Strong in 2025
summary: The VictoryShares Free Cash Flow ETF (VFLO) demonstrated strong demand in 2024 and is well-positioned for 2025, offering diversification, attractive valuations, and strong historical returns. VFLO targets large-cap U.S. companies with high free cash flow yields, excluding "Magnificent Seven" stocks, making it a valuable complement to broad benchmarks. Its performance in 2024, generating a nearly 22% return, highlights its potential to improve value exposure in portfolios.

title: Oracle misses on earnings and issues weak revenue guidance
summary: Oracle reported fiscal third-quarter results that fell short of analysts' expectations for both earnings and revenue, and issued weak revenue guidance for the current quarter. Despite this, the company's cloud infrastructure unit continued to see strong growth due to AI demand, with revenue up 49% from the previous year. Oracle also announced an increase in its quarterly dividend to 50 cents a share.

title: Is It Time to Buy the Magnificent Seven?
summary: After a recent selloff in the US stock market, the valuations of the "Magnificent Seven" mega-cap tech stocks have decreased. Morningstar analysts now consider Meta, Amazon, Microsoft, and Alphabet to be undervalued, while Nvidia and Tesla are fairly valued, and Apple remains overvalued. Despite these changes, Morningstar strategists continue to recommend underweighting growth stocks, favoring a rotation into value stocks.

title: Live Nation: Total tickets sold by Ticketmaster annually (2010-2024)
summary: This article examines the annual number of tickets sold by Ticketmaster, a Live Nation Entertainment platform, from 2010 to 2024. It details how Live Nation reports these figures in its financial updates, including both primary and secondary, fee-bearing and non-fee-bearing tickets. The data visualization is based on this information, offering insights into Ticketmaster's sales volume over the years.

title: Druva debuts fully integrated support for Microsoft Azure
summary: Druva, a SaaS platform for data security and backup, has introduced integrated support for Microsoft Azure, expanding its services beyond its decade-long AWS exclusivity. This move allows Druva customers to backup Microsoft Azure and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud VMs to Azure Storage, with further services planned through a strategic partnership with Microsoft. The development addresses the growing multi-cloud environment used by enterprises and positions Druva to meet broader market demands.

title: UNFI sees sales rise as efficiency improves
summary: United Natural Foods, Inc. (UNFI) reported a nearly 5% year-over-year rise in net sales to $8.2 billion in Q2 fiscal 2025, driven by its natural products business, while narrowing its net loss to $3 million. The company's wholesale operations saw an increase in adjusted EBITDA, while the retail division experienced a slight decline due to store closures, though identical store sales largely improved. UNFI also focused on efficiency, improving safety, delivery quality, and productivity at its facilities, and plans to use proceeds from distribution center sales to reduce debt.

title: $120M TowneBank-Village Bank acquisition approved by state, FDIC
summary: TowneBank's $120 million acquisition of Midlothian’s Village Bank and Trust Financial Corp. has received approval from the FDIC and the Virginia State Corporation Commission. This clearance paves the way for the deal to be completed in early April. The combined entity will operate under the TowneBank name, boasting approximately $17.8 billion in assets and incorporating Village Bank's nine branch offices into its network.

title: Board Approves Termination of Investment Sub-Advisory Agreement for First Trust TCW Securitized Plus ETF
summary: First Trust Advisors L.P. announced that the Board of Trustees of First Trust Exchange-Traded Fund VIII voted to terminate the investment sub-advisory agreement for the First Trust TCW Securitized Plus ETF, effective May 9, 2025. First Trust Advisors L.P. will assume portfolio management responsibilities for the Fund, maintaining existing investment strategies. The company, along with its affiliate First Trust Portfolios L.P., manages approximately $266 billion in collective assets.

title: Bank of America stock hits 52-week high at 53.64 USD
summary: Bank of America's stock reached a 52-week high of $53.64, driven by a 29.71% increase over the past year and strong investor confidence. This performance follows a solid third-quarter revenue report and increased adoption of its AI-powered financial tools. The bank also made significant executive appointments and its analysts commented on market-influencing investment deals.

title: Tech Moves: Longtime Google leader Umesh Shankar joins Microsoft as new corporate VP
summary: Umesh Shankar, a veteran leader from Google, has joined Microsoft AI as a corporate vice president of engineering, focusing on privacy and security for the Copilot AI assistant. This move is part of a trend of Google executives moving to Microsoft AI. The article also details other significant personnel changes at Remitly, Crelate, Bloomberg, Pioneer Square Labs, Seattle Aquarium, Built Oregon, Fred Hutch Cancer Center, and Trove.

title: Is it time to buy the Magnificent Seven?
summary: The "Magnificent Seven" tech stocks have experienced a significant selloff, making some of them appear undervalued according to Morningstar's fair value metrics. While Meta, Amazon, Microsoft, and Alphabet are now rated as buys, Nvidia and Tesla are fairly valued, and Apple remains overvalued. Morningstar strategists still recommend underweighting growth stocks overall, favoring value stocks due to market volatility and slowing economic growth.

title: The maker of Roomba has ‘substantial doubt’ about surviving
summary: iRobot, the maker of Roomba, has expressed "substantial doubt" about its ability to continue as a company, according to its latest quarterly earnings report. This dire warning follows the collapse of a planned $1.7 billion acquisition by Amazon due to regulatory concerns. The company's stock plummeted 30% in premarket trading, and its board is now exploring strategic alternatives amidst mounting debt.

title: FEPI Stock Fund Price and Chart — NASDAQ:FEPI
summary: This article provides an overview of the REX FANG & Innovation Equity Premium Income ETF (FEPI), detailing its price performance, key statistics like AUM and dividend yield, and investment strategy. FEPI employs a covered call strategy on top US technology companies, aiming for income generation and limited capital appreciation. The fund's historical performance, asset allocation, and technical analysis indicators are also presented.

title: CVS SWOT Analysis (2025)
summary: This article provides a comprehensive SWOT analysis of CVS for the year 2025, detailing its strengths such as reliable suppliers, large scale, and strong brand name, alongside weaknesses like inventory management and high staff turnover. It also identifies opportunities in technology investment, online channels, and diversification through acquisitions, while highlighting threats from local distributors, regulation risks, and inflation. The analysis evaluates CVS's current market position and potential future challenges and growth areas.

title: Fossil leans on layoffs, more store closures to cut costs
summary: Fossil Group is implementing layoffs and closing approximately 50 more stores to save $100 million in selling, general, and administrative expenses after a Q4 net sales plunge of nearly 19%. The company aims to shift its focus towards its wholesale channel and make its direct-to-consumer business smaller but more profitable. Former Casper CFO Randy Greben has been hired as the new CFO to help lead these business transformations and turnarounds.

title: Fossil Group names new CFO
summary: Fossil Group has appointed Randy Greben as its new chief financial officer, effective March 17. Greben will be responsible for overseeing the company's global financial strategy, with a focus on its financial turnaround and business transformation. He brings over two decades of financial leadership experience from companies like Casper Sleep, Blue Apron, and Ann Inc.

title: E-Commerce Automotive Aftermarket Size, Share | CAGR of 22.4%
summary: The global E-Commerce Automotive Aftermarket is projected to grow from USD 67.4 Billion in 2024 to USD 508.7 Billion by 2034, exhibiting a CAGR of 22.4%. This growth is driven by digitalization, increasing vehicle ownership, and consumer preference for online shopping, with North America currently dominating the market. Key trends include AI-powered recommendations, mobile-friendly platforms, omnichannel strategies, and the emergence of eco-friendly auto parts.

title: Target engages in grocery war by arming supply chain
summary: Target is enhancing its food supply chain by increasing its temperature-controlled food distribution centers from nine to ten, aiming to ensure products remain in stock during peak shopping periods. This strategic move is part of Target's effort to compete with grocery giants like Walmart and Amazon, despite recent struggles in overall earnings. The retailer also plans to focus on offering a wider assortment of goods and faster delivery services to consumers, building on its $6.5 billion in food and beverage sales in the first quarter, which saw low single-digit growth.

title: Starbucks CEO defends company's diversity, says they are 'key' strength of business
summary: Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol emphasized at a recent shareholder meeting that diversity remains a core strength for the company. Despite other corporations scaling back on diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) initiatives, Niccol asserted that reflecting the diversity of customers and staff globally is crucial for Starbucks, which operates 40,000 stores in 88 markets. He added that a diverse board of directors is also vital for the company's success.

title: Roomba maker says 'substantial doubt' about future of company
summary: iRobot, the company behind Roomba vacuums, has issued a warning of "substantial doubt" about its ability to continue as a going concern, citing a significant revenue decrease and annual net loss in fiscal 2024. The company is evaluating a "broad range of alternatives" for its business, including debt refinancing and transactions, after facing aggressive competition and the termination of a proposed acquisition by Amazon. These challenges come even as iRobot launched new robot vacuum models and implemented an operational restructuring to focus on profitability.

title: Oracle Mission Statement | Sustainability Goals | Core Values | Strategy (2025 Analysis)
summary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of Oracle's mission statement, corporate responsibility, sustainability goals, and core values as of 2025. It details how Oracle aims to help customers manage and leverage data, promote technological freedom, and contribute to a sustainable environment through various initiatives and its commitment to values like integrity, customer satisfaction, and teamwork. The article also provides key financial and company information for Oracle.

title: Stock Market Today: Dow Sinks 537 Points On Tariff Threats As S&P 500 Corrects; Gold Miners Jump, Meta Triggers Sell Rule (Live Coverage)
summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 537 points, and the S&P 500 corrected amid new tariff threats from the Trump administration. Gold miners rallied while Home Depot and Meta Platforms experienced sell-offs, with Meta triggering a sell rule. Despite a late attempt by traders to cover short positions, major indexes ended the trading day lower.

title: Applied Optoelectronics Soars Following Share Purchase Agreement With Amazon
summary: Shares of Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI) are experiencing a significant surge, climbing over 35 percent, following the announcement of a share purchase agreement with Amazon. Amazon.com, Inc. has been issued a warrant to acquire approximately 8 million shares, as disclosed in a recent SEC filing. This news has led to a boost in AAOI's stock price, which traded at $21.60 on Friday morning.

title: GE Vernova, Amazon Expand Effort to Address Surge in Global Energy Demand
summary: GE Vernova and Amazon Web Services (AWS) are expanding their collaboration to address rising global energy demand and advance decarbonization goals. GE Vernova will provide essential electrical equipment and construction support to AWS for its data center expansion, while also working on onshore wind development projects. AWS, in turn, will offer cloud services to GE Vernova, aiding its cloud migration, digital innovation, and the use of generative AI to optimize operations and accelerate technology development.

title: ETF Spotlight: XLY Plunges With Consumer Sentiment
summary: The Consumer Discretionary Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLY) has been a poor performer in 2025 due to declining consumer sentiment, triggered by economic uncertainty, inflation fears, and a trade war. Despite short-term struggles, the article suggests this downturn could be a buying opportunity for long-term investors, as consumer spending tends to rebound. XLY, heavily weighted with Amazon and Tesla, offers exposure to leading consumer brands but carries risks like cyclicality and concentration.

title: Five Investment Themes to Watch in Equity and Alternative for 2025
summary: In 2025, investors are focusing on diversification and risk management due to shifting macroeconomic conditions, a new U.S. administration, and evolving trade policies. Key investment themes include diversifying within U.S. equities, increasing exposure to international equities, particularly in Japan, and utilizing commodities and cryptocurrencies for portfolio diversification and inflation hedging. The article highlights the role of CME Group's various futures and options contracts in managing these investment strategies.

title: Summit Therapeutics (SMMT) reports inducement grants
summary: Summit Therapeutics (SMMT) announced the grant of inducement awards consisting of options to purchase 122,650 shares of common stock to 12 new employees. These awards, granted on March 11, 2025, have an exercise price of $18.50 per share and vest in equal annual installments over four years. The grants were made to attract new employees, in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

title: NEOS Nasdaq-100 Hedged Equity Income ETF Review and Aggregate Rating (QQQH)
summary: The NEOS Nasdaq-100 Hedged Equity Income ETF (QQQH) has an aggregate rating of "Moderate Buy" based on analysis of its holdings. MarketBeat calculates this rating and a price target by considering Wall Street analyst ratings for the individual stocks within the ETF's portfolio. The aggregate price target for QQQH is $53.32, with its top holdings including NVIDIA, Apple, Microsoft, and Amazon.com.

title: Western Digital unveils 26TB 3.5-inch Red Pro SATA NAS HDD
summary: Western Digital has launched a new 26TB 3.5-inch WD Red Pro hard drive (WD260KFGX) designed for network-attached storage (NAS) devices. This new drive uses conventional magnetic recording (CMR) technology, offering high capacity and reliability with a 2.5-million-hour mean time between failure (MTBF) rating and 550 TB per year of data transfers. It is priced at $569.99 and is optimized for demanding, always-on NAS usage, including RAID settings, with anti-vibration technology and OptiNAND.

title: My Health, My Dollar: Amazon’s Health Data Troubles in Washington
summary: Amazon is facing a first-of-its-kind lawsuit under Washington’s My Health My Data Act (MHMDA), alleging unauthorized collection and monetization of health-related data through its SDKs without user consent. The case highlights the MHMDA's strict requirements, which go beyond HIPAA, and its provision for a private right of action. This legal challenge underscores the increasing scrutiny on companies handling consumer health information and necessitates a re-evaluation of data privacy practices to align with evolving legal landscapes.

summary: L.B. Foster (NASDAQ: FSTR) is set to announce its Q1 earnings before market hours tomorrow. summary: Shares of Hims & Hers, a San Francisco telehealth company, have experienced significant volatility recently, surging after a strong earnings report before dipping due to a cautious Q2 outlook, and then rebounding. summary: Viant Technology Inc. summary: IonQ announced its first-quarter 2025 financial results, reporting revenue of $7.6 million and cash, cash equivalents, and investments totaling $697.1 million. summary: ServiceNow announced new Workflow Data Fabric capabilities, including the Workflow Data Network, a broad ecosystem connecting data platforms, applications, and tools on the ServiceNow AI Platform. title: The Gig Trap: Algorithmic, Wage and Labor Exploitation in Platform Work in the US | HRW
summary: This Human Rights Watch report details how digital labor platforms in the US exploit workers through algorithmic management, wage opacity, and misclassification as independent contractors, denying them crucial labor protections and social security benefits. The report, based on extensive interviews and surveys with gig workers in states like Texas, reveals widespread financial insecurity, low wages—often below minimum wage after expenses—and vulnerability to arbitrary deactivations and on-the-job hazards. It calls for urgent regulatory reforms, including proper employment classification using the "ABC test," algorithmic fairness, guaranteed living wages, adequate social protection, and strengthened worker bargaining power to ensure platform workers' human rights are upheld.

title: Amazon.com (AMZN) Turns Up the Heat in CTV Ad Wars With Fresh DSP Discounts
summary: Amazon (AMZN) is intensifying competition in the Connected TV (CTV) advertising market by offering discounts on its Demand-Side Platform (DSP) to attract marketers.
