Despite strong competition from The Trade Desk, Amazon is closely watched by investors as it navigates the digital advertising landscape.

title: Whisper-quiet electric helicopter-plane could turn NYC into ‘The Jetsons’
summary: BETA Technologies' electric aircraft, ALIA, completed its first North American passenger flight from East Hampton to JFK, demonstrating significant advancements in quiet, affordable, and emission-free air travel. This milestone, fueled by only $8 worth of electricity, signifies a step towards transforming urban transportation in New York City, potentially enabling quiet vertiports and connecting the city by air like "The Jetsons." While commercial vertical flights are anticipated within a year and full commercial service within two years, the company has already secured over $1 billion in funding and built an extensive charging network.

title: 1 ETF to Buy Hand Over Fist to Follow the TACO Trade
summary: The article discusses the "TACO" trade strategy, which involves buying into the market on the assumption that Donald Trump will reverse course on tariffs. It highlights the Consumer Discretionary Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLY) as a key ETF for this strategy due to its liquidity, the strong momentum of the consumer discretionary sector, and improved consumer confidence. The XLY ETF invests in U.S. consumer discretionary companies across various industries.

title: Lifeway Foods Expands Retail Footprint with Thousands of New Lifeway Kefir and Farmer Cheese Placements Across Major U.S. Retailers in 2025
summary: Lifeway Foods announced a significant expansion of its retail footprint in 2025, adding thousands of new placements for its kefir and farmer cheese products across major U.S. retailers. The company reported strong financial performance with net sales exceeding $37.6 million for the first two months of Q2 2025 and year-to-date net sales reaching $83.7 million. Lifeway attributes this growth to increasing consumer demand for functional, gut-healthy foods, driven partly by social media trends.

title: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2025
summary: Apple Machine Learning Research will be participating in the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2025 in Nashville, Tennessee, from June 11 to June 15. The company will present new research at the annual conference, featuring workshop talks, poster sessions, oral presentations, booth programming, and technical demos. Apple is also sponsoring the event, aiming to connect with the scientific and industrial research communities in computer vision.

title: Bausch + Lomb launches new dry eye drops in U.S. stores
summary: Bausch + Lomb (NYSE/TSX: BLCO) has introduced two new eye care products, Blink Nourish and Blink Boost, in the U.S. market, expanding its Blink range of dry eye drops. Blink Nourish is the first vitamin-enriched, preservative-free eye drop, while Blink Boost features a pH-balanced formula inspired by the DEWS II report. These products are now available at major national retailers, offering long-lasting relief for individuals with dry eye symptoms and sensitivities.

title: June 2025: Stablecoin Summer
summary: The article "June 2025: Stablecoin Summer" by Grayscale Research highlights a period of significant positive developments for stablecoins both fundamentally and legislatively. It discusses the passage of the GENIUS Act in the Senate, Circle's successful IPO, and increasing corporate interest in stablecoins from major companies like Amazon and Walmart. The piece also notes supportive macroeconomic policies and regulatory clarity driving strong performance in the Currencies and Financials Crypto Sectors and increasing activity in prediction markets like Polymarket.

title: Why Lumen isn't pitching itself as a telco
summary: Lumen Technologies is moving away from being seen as a traditional telco, with President and CEO Kate Johnson stating that telcos have ceded too much innovation to tech companies. Following the sale of its mass market fiber business, Lumen is now focusing on building infrastructure for AI services, securing partnerships with major cloud providers, and emphasizing connectivity for data centers. The company is actively working to convince Wall Street of its strategic pivot despite recent stock declines.

title: Top 10: Autonomous Vehicle Companies
summary: This article ranks the top 10 autonomous vehicle companies that are revolutionizing the transport industry through significant investments in self-driving technology. Key players like Waymo, NVIDIA, Tesla, and Mercedes-Benz are highlighted for their contributions to improving safety, scaling operations, and enhancing vehicle connectivity. The companies are advancing different levels of automation, from advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) to fully autonomous robotaxis.

title: Old Dominion Blames ‘Economic Softness’ for Revenue, Volume Slips
summary: Old Dominion Freight Line reported a 5.8% daily revenue decrease in May, attributing it to "economic softness" impacting demand and volumes. The less-than-truckload (LTL) giant also saw an 8.4% decrease in LTL tons per day. This comes as the trucking industry faces challenges like tariffs and a prolonged freight recession, with rival XPO also reporting negative tonnage figures and Yellow Corp. continuing to liquidate assets.

title: Cathie Wood Snaps Up Amazon and AMD Stocks but Offloads Palantir and CoreWeave
summary: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest ETFs recently acquired significant shares of Amazon (AMZN) and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD), signaling confidence in these tech giants' growth potential despite market concerns. Conversely, ARK offloaded shares of Palantir Technologies (PLTR) and CoreWeave (CRWV), with analysts noting valuation concerns for both. Wood also made other notable purchases including Guardant Health Inc. (GH) and 10X Genomics Inc. (TXG).

title: Walmart plans to expand drone deliveries to three more states
summary: Walmart announced plans to expand its drone delivery service to 100 stores in Atlanta, Charlotte, Houston, Orlando, and Tampa within the next year, bringing the total number of states offering the service to five. This expansion aims to enhance convenience for customers, who typically order urgent items like groceries or medicines. While Walmart and Amazon have had slow rollouts of drone delivery, Walmart has completed over 150,000 drone deliveries since 2021.

title: Chunghwa Telecom acquires OneWeb satellite service license
summary: Chunghwa Telecom has secured Taiwan's first commercial license to use Eutelsat OneWeb low-earth orbit (LEO) satellite services after passing regulatory hurdles. The company also plans to build a satellite service terminal testing center with Eutelsat OneWeb in Taiwan. This move is part of the operator's broader satellite strategy, which includes other partnerships and investments, to enhance network redundancy in Taiwan.

title: $900M dairy plant with 200 jobs fires up in Eastern WA. Biggest in the Northwest
summary: Darigold has officially opened its new $900 million dairy processing plant in Pasco, Washington, six months behind its revised schedule. This plant, the largest in the Northwest, will process 8 million pounds of milk daily into butter and powdered milk, employing 200 people. Despite significant cost overruns due to inflation and updated building codes, Darigold sees this as a crucial investment for its future, though it has led to temporary milk payment cuts for member farmers.

title: From Oreos to eggrolls, snack giants fire legal shots over labels, logos and loyalty
summary: The snack industry is experiencing a surge in lawsuits as major brands like Kellogg’s, PepsiCo, Mondelēz, and Conagra take aggressive legal action to defend their trademarks, claims, and product integrity. These cases range from trademark infringement over food truck names to class actions regarding expired promotions, misleading "natural" claims, contaminated products, and exaggerated nutritional content. The litigation highlights a growing intolerance for copycat packaging, ambiguous health claims, and supply chain quality issues, signaling a need for increased transparency and legal defensibility in marketing.

title: Walmart Inc. Signs 338,000-SF Lease at Jay Paul Company’s Iconic Tech Corners Campus in Sunnyvale
summary: Walmart Inc.'s eCommerce division has signed a 338,307-square-foot lease at Jay Paul Company’s Tech Corners in Sunnyvale, California, marking the largest new office lease in Silicon Valley since 2023. This expansion strengthens Walmart's presence in the region within a modernized, wellness-focused campus. The transaction highlights robust momentum in Silicon Valley's office leasing market, particularly in Sunnyvale.

title: XOVR ETF Adds Anduril, Joining SpaceX to Offer Pre-IPO Access
summary: ERShares, through its XOVR ETF, has added Anduril Industries as a new private equity position, offering retail investors access to pre-IPO companies. This move follows previous investments in SpaceX and Klarna, with Anduril becoming the second-largest private holding for XOVR. The ETF aims to provide diversified, liquid access to high-growth public companies and elite pre-IPO firms, leveraging a proprietary research model to identify category-defining companies.

title: Genpact acquires AI solutions provider XponentL Data to boost capabilities
summary: Genpact has acquired XponentL Data, an AI solutions and data products provider, to enhance its capabilities in data, AI, and advanced technologies. This acquisition aims to support clients through the AI transformation lifecycle, bringing specialized domain-led data strategy and engineering skills, particularly in life sciences and healthcare, and strengthening partnerships with major platforms like AWS and Microsoft. Genpact CEO Balkrishan Kalra believes this will further enable the company to help clients extract full value from their data.

title: Nvidia Back in Focus and AI Infrastructure Acceleration
summary: This article analyzes Nvidia's recent earnings call, highlighting the accelerating pace of innovation and capital expenditure in the semiconductor and AI infrastructure sectors. It emphasizes the shift from Nvidia being the sole focus to a broader ecosystem including fabless designers and custom silicon, suggesting diversified exposure through ETFs like SMH and SMHX is crucial for investors. The continued surge in AI adoption and associated compute demand underscores the long-term potential of the semiconductor industry.

title: Amazon robotics program expansion to unlock billions in savings, boosting margins
summary: Amazon's growing investment in robotics, including the potential use of humanoid robots for package delivery, is expected to generate significant long-term cost savings and enhance margins, according to Bank of America analysts. They project over $7.1 billion in annual savings by 2032 from delivery robotics, excluding humanoid robots, and believe this strategy could lift Amazon's retail margins to 11%. This expansion also strengthens Amazon's position in AI beyond AWS to its retail operations.

title: eBay Charges Sellers Ad Fees Months After Sales In Apparent Attribution Snafu
summary: eBay is reportedly charging sellers ad fees months after sales have completed, which the company claims is due to a "system error" that missed previous attribution for promoted listings. This issue has led to frustration among sellers, who are questioning eBay's transparency and demanding refunds, especially given past instances of similar technical issues with fee collection. Critics suggest the multi-billion dollar corporation should absorb these costs rather than penalize sellers, urging those affected to report the issue to the Federal Trade Commission.

title: Firm Advises IonQ on Acquisition of Lightsynq Technologies
summary: Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati advised IonQ, a quantum computing and networking company, on its acquisition of Lightsynq Technologies Inc. Lightsynq, founded by former Harvard quantum memory experts, specializes in photonic interconnect platforms crucial for advanced quantum systems. This acquisition is expected to significantly accelerate IonQ’s quantum networking and computing roadmaps and expand its patent portfolio with over 20 new patents related to quantum memory.

title: Why Is Everyone Talking About Coupang's Stock?
summary: Coupang, often called the "Amazon of South Korea," has gained significant attention from investors due to its strong performance, including a 25% stock price increase in the last year and consistent revenue growth. The company is known for its customer-centric approach, extensive logistics, and expansion into new services and geographies. Coupang's recent $1 billion share buyback plan also signals management's confidence in its future and commitment to long-term shareholder value.

title: Exclusive / Netflix buys Daily Beast TV pilot as it races against YouTube
summary: Netflix has acquired a pilot television series from The Daily Beast, produced with Bright North Studios, a move signaling its interest in quickly produced, topical documentary-style content. This initiative suggests Netflix is looking to compete more directly with YouTube for audience eyeballs, despite its CEO Ted Sarandos previously downplaying YouTube as a talent competitor. The potential success of The Daily Beast series could be a significant win for the publication's new leadership, which has focused on cost reduction and an editorial overhaul, leading to its recent profitability.

title: Plug Power CFO Paul Middleton Underscores Continued Confidence in Strategic Growth with Additional Share Purchase
summary: Plug Power CFO Paul Middleton purchased an additional 650,000 shares of Plug Power common stock on the open market, investing at an average price of $1.0339 per share. This latest acquisition, following a previous purchase, signifies Middleton's strong belief in the company's long-term strategy, financial trajectory, and leadership in the green hydrogen economy. He emphasized Plug's operational progress, including the ramp-up of hydrogen production and commercialization of electrolyzers, as key drivers for this investment.

summary: United Natural Foods Inc. (UNFI.N), a major U.S. grocery distributor for clients including Whole Foods, experienced a cyber incident that led to the company taking certain systems offline. summary: Chunghwa Telecom has secured Taiwan's first commercial license to operate low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite services using Eutelsat OneWeb technology, a significant step for the country's network resilience. The company aims to provide satellite-based services to government agencies and various industries, planning to establish a satellite service terminal testing center in Taiwan. This initiative is part of a broader strategy to enhance communications resilience, including investments in high- and low-orbit satellite systems and discussions with other global satellite providers like Amazon's Kuiper and Canada's Telesat.

title: TD Cowen: Oracle seeking 5GW US data center capacity for OpenAI training workloads by end of 2026
summary: Oracle is reportedly seeking 5GW of US data center capacity for OpenAI's training workloads by the end of 2026, a move that could entail a five-year partnership costing over $159 billion. This deal, separate from the Abilene Stargate campus, involves Oracle procuring data center capacity built to OpenAI's specifications, with pricing around $2.60-3.00 per GPU per hour for approximately 2.3 million GPUs. title: North America Consumer Electronics Market Size, Share, 2033
summary: The North America Consumer Electronics Market was valued at USD 245.11 billion in 2024 and is projected to reach USD 369.62 billion by 2033, growing at a CAGR of 4.67% from 2025 to 2033. Key drivers include rising disposable incomes, urbanization, and advancements in 5G and IoT technologies, while challenges involve supply chain disruptions, rapid technological obsolescence, and intense competition from budget brands. Smartphones dominate product categories, and retail stores remain the primary distribution channel, though e-commerce is rapidly expanding.

summary: Maximus has announced the latest version of its Total Experience Management (TXM) solution, featuring new integrations with Amazon Web Services (AWS). Maximus TXM aims to help federal agencies deliver services more efficiently, improve customer experience, and achieve mission outcomes, as demonstrated by its application at the Department of Veterans Affairs and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services.

summary: Maximus has launched an updated version of its Total Experience Management (TXM) platform, now integrated with Amazon Web Services (AWS). title: Walmart Just Made a Game-Changing Announcement, and Everyone Else Will Have to Play Catch-Up
summary: Walmart has announced a significant expansion of its drone delivery service, making it the first retailer to scale this technology across five states: Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, and Texas. This move will allow millions of customers in major cities like Atlanta, Charlotte, Houston, Orlando, and Tampa to receive orders, including items like ice cream and eggs, within minutes via drone. The company is partnering with firms like Zipline and Wing (an Alphabet subsidiary) to fulfill deliveries from Walmart parking lots, with drones flying up to 6 miles and lowering packages via tether, returning at speeds up to 65 mph.

title: Op-Ed: Why AI Companies Should Pay Media Organizations For Their Content
summary: The article argues that AI companies should pay media organizations for using their content, citing The New York Times' licensing deal with Amazon as a successful example. It highlights the shift from AI companies using copyrighted material without permission to paying for intellectual property, which creates accountability and helps publishers struggling with traffic. The author suggests that more artists and publishers should pursue similar deals to protect their work and ensure they are compensated for their contributions to AI training.

title: Alliance Forms New Home Entertainment Division, Adds Personnel
summary: Alliance Entertainment Holding Corp. has created Alliance Home Entertainment, a new division that merges Mill Creek Entertainment and Distribution Solutions to centralize film and television distribution. This new entity aims to be a leading platform for physical and digital distribution by leveraging strategic investments in infrastructure, partnerships, and talent. The division will focus on expanding premium offerings and maintaining growth in legacy formats, led by EVP Robert Oram and a team of seasoned professionals.

title: Roblox Hires Paramount's CFO: Will Naveen Chopra Fuel The Platform's Next Big Leap?
summary: Roblox Corporation announced Naveen Chopra will become its new Chief Financial Officer, effective June 30, 2025, succeeding Michael Guthrie. Chopra previously held CFO roles at Paramount Global and oversaw Amazon.com's Devices and Services division. His appointment is expected to align product innovation with financial execution as Roblox continues to grow in digital entertainment and community building.

title: TOPT ETF: Historical Outperformance Can Continue (NYSEARCA:TOPT)
summary: The iShares Top 20 U.S. Stocks ETF (TOPT) provides concentrated exposure to the largest U.S. companies and has shown strong performance despite higher volatility. title: Progyny Joins Amazon’s Health Benefits Connector Program as First Women’s Health and Family Building Solution
summary: Progyny, a global leader in women’s health and family building solutions, announced its collaboration with Amazon’s Health Benefits Connector. This partnership aims to expand access for eligible Amazon customers to discover and enroll in Progyny's comprehensive women's health services, including fertility, family building, and menopause benefits. The initiative addresses the challenge of individuals not understanding their available health benefits, simplifying the process of accessing high-quality, inclusive care.

title: Hiring confidence steady in India for July–September; IT, energy and BFSI to lead recruitment push, says ManpowerGroup employment outlook survey
summary: Corporate India expects robust hiring for July-September 2025, driven by strong employer confidence in IT, energy, and financial sectors. The Net Employment Outlook stands at 42%, ranking second globally after the UAE, and marks a significant year-on-year increase. Despite global trade headwinds, companies are increasing investment in automation and adapting their workforce strategies to meet new skill demands, with Energy & Utilities, IT, and Financial Services showing the strongest outlooks.

title: Arrive AI Secures Another Key Patent for its Smart Mailbox-Anchored Autonomous Last-Mile Delivery Solutions Platform
summary: Arrive AI (ARAI) has secured its eighth U.S. patent for temperature control features within its Arrive Points™ smart mailbox platform, enhancing its autonomous last-mile delivery solutions. This patent, along with 58 others pending globally, strengthens the company's intellectual property and positions its technology to significantly impact healthcare delivery by enabling safe transport of temperature-sensitive items and pharmaceuticals. The technology also includes features like hazardous material detection, sanitization, and facial recognition, with CEO Dan O'Toole noting its foundational smart mailbox patent pre-dated Amazon's by four days.

title: Latin America industrial market overview 2025
summary: JLL Research published an overview of the Latin America industrial market for 2025, highlighting positive signals and an encouraging outlook. The article notes the significant changes in the logistics market driven by the COVID-19 pandemic, leading to accelerated e-commerce growth and increased demand for high-end industrial parks, particularly from retail companies. This suggests continued expansion and evolution in the region's industrial sector.

title: Whole Foods Distributor United Natural Foods Hit by Cyberattack
summary: United Natural Foods (UNFI), the primary distributor for Whole Foods, has experienced a cyberattack that disrupted its IT systems and business operations. The company, which has over $30 billion in annual revenue and distributes to 30,000+ locations, took some systems offline to address the intrusion. UNFI is investigating the incident and working to restore services, with its shares falling following the announcement.

title: Alliance Entertainment Launches Alliance Home Entertainment Division to Drive Future of Film and TV Distribution
summary: Alliance Entertainment has announced the formation of a new division, Alliance Home Entertainment, to centralize film and television distribution. This new division combines Mill Creek Entertainment, Distribution Solutions, and new strategic hires to better serve studios, retailers, and fans. The company aims to lead the evolution of physical and digital media by focusing on growth in legacy formats and expanding premium offerings, reinforcing its commitment to the home entertainment category.

title: AES Completes First Phase of Largest Solar-Plus-Storage Project in the United States
summary: The AES Corporation has completed the first phase (1,000 MW) of its Bellefield solar-plus-storage project, the largest in the U.S., under a 15-year contract with Amazon. This phase consists of 500 MW of solar and 500 MW of battery storage. The total 2,000 MW project, located in Kern County, California, is expected to displace over 1 million metric tons of CO2 annually and created over 700 union jobs, with more anticipated for the second phase, which is on track for completion in 2026.

title: Stargate partner Crusoe lands $750 million credit line for AI buildout
summary: Crusoe, an infrastructure startup partnered with OpenAI on the Stargate data center project, has secured a $750 million credit line from Brookfield Asset Management. This funding will be used to build data centers, acquire Nvidia chips, and develop electrical infrastructure to support the large-scale AI project. The company, which builds its own data centers unlike some competitors, was valued at $2.8 billion in its December funding round.

title: Keep cool and save: Get a free smart thermostat this summer on us
summary: Entergy Louisiana is offering residential customers up to two free smart thermostats to help them manage energy consumption and save on utility bills during the summer. These smart devices learn user habits, adjust temperatures automatically, and can be controlled remotely via a smartphone. Customers can choose from three models, including options from Amazon and Sensi, available through the Entergy Solutions Marketplace without promo codes, shipping fees, or taxes.

title: Untapped potential of AI in the insurance sector: Genpact
summary: A Genpact report, in collaboration with AWS, reveals that despite 69% AI adoption in the insurance sector, only 36% of US customers experience improved digital services, highlighting a significant gap in scaling AI for customer experience and growth. Challenges include low customer trust in AI-driven quotes, underutilization of AI for monetization, governance issues, data privacy concerns, and a talent gap in AI fluency among insurance executives. The report proposes a six-point strategic blueprint for insurers to effectively scale AI and build trust.

title: NVIDIA DGX Cloud Lepton Connects Europe’s Developers to Global NVIDIA Compute Ecosystem
summary: NVIDIA has expanded its DGX Cloud Lepton platform, a global compute marketplace for AI application developers, by welcoming new cloud providers including Mistral AI, Nebius, and Scaleway, in addition to AWS and Microsoft Azure. This expansion aims to increase access to high-performance NVIDIA Blackwell and other architecture GPUs in Europe while allowing data to remain local for sovereign AI requirements. To further support the AI ecosystem, Hugging Face is integrating DGX Cloud Lepton into its Training Cluster as a Service, and NVIDIA is partnering with European venture capital firms to offer marketplace credits to startups.

title: Oklo Stock Soars After U.S. Air Force Nuclear Energy Deal
summary: Oklo Inc., a nuclear energy startup, has been selected by the U.S. Air Force as the preferred contractor to build a microreactor at Eielson Air Force Base in Alaska. This deal highlights increasing military confidence in nuclear microreactor technology for off-grid power in challenging environments. The company's Aurora microreactors are designed to use recycled nuclear waste and operate for up to 10 years without refueling, with their stock price rising significantly in 2025 due to investor interest and progress.

title: A Major Cosmetic Retail Chain Is Suddenly Closing A Big Store And It Is A Cause For Concern
summary: Ulta Beauty is closing its South Loop Chicago store after 13 years, following a trend of anchor tenants leaving the shopping center. This closure reflects broader shifts in consumer habits towards online shopping and away from physical stores, exacerbated by macroeconomic pressures and increased e-commerce competition. Ulta has launched a turnaround plan focusing on e-commerce and selective real estate decisions to regain market share, while competitor Sephora shows strong growth.

summary: KraneShares has launched the KraneShares 2X Long MELI Daily ETF (KMLI), providing 200% leveraged daily exposure to Mercado Libre, a leading e-commerce platform in Latin America. summary: Oracle's shares surged 13% to a record high following robust earnings that surpassed analyst expectations and an optimistic forecast driven by its cloud business. summary: Morgan Stanley released a major report titled "AI Agents Knocking at the Door," highlighting that AI Agents are poised to become the next significant evolutionary direction in the software industry, with a market opportunity expected to grow from $52 billion to $102 billion by 2028. title: First stage of Amazon’s 4 GWh Californian solar-plus-storage site is built
summary: AES Corp has completed the first 1 GW solar plus 1 GW/2 GWh battery storage stage of the Bellefield project in California for Amazon. title: Estée Lauder Launches in the Amazon.ca Premium Beauty Store
summary: Estée Lauder has officially launched its brand in the Amazon.ca Premium Beauty store, expanding access to its skincare, makeup, and fragrances for Canadian customers. summary: Oracle's stock experienced its best week since 2001, surging 24% after a strong earnings report indicated significant momentum in its cloud business. The company is restructuring after pandemic-era over-hiring and focusing on expanding the adoption of artificial intelligence tools, which its CEO believes will lead to more automation and corporate job losses. These cuts contribute to a broader goal of trimming about 30,000 corporate roles across various departments.

title: The AI Data Lake: A Deep-Dive into Western Digital’s (WDC) Resurgence in 2026

Despite risks associated with technological transitions and industry cyclicality, strong leadership and market position make WDC a compelling investment in 2026.

title: Can AI-upscaled 4K streams stay sharp? Beamr and NVIDIA test it
summary: Beamr (NASDAQ: BMR) is set to showcase a validation framework for AI-enhanced and compressed video at Mile High Video 2026, from February 2-5. This framework, developed in collaboration with NVIDIA, combines RTX Video Super Resolution, GStreamer integration, and Beamr’s Content-Adaptive Bitrate (CABR) technology to ensure perceptual quality while significantly reducing video file sizes. The demonstration will highlight how 720p content can be upgraded to live 4Kp60, with CABR achieving up to 50% size reduction, addressing critical verification challenges for streaming platforms and broadcasters.

title: Beamr Imaging Ltd. to Showcase Video Quality Validation Framework at Mile High Video 2026 in Denver
summary: Beamr Imaging Ltd. will showcase its video quality validation framework at the Mile High Video 2026 conference from February 2-5 in Denver, Colorado. The company's technology addresses critical challenges in compression and AI-enhanced video workflows, ensuring that Ultra HD content maintains visual quality while reducing file sizes by up to 50% using its patented CABR technology. This framework aims to help media teams confidently transition to live 4K delivery and deploy innovative technologies without compromising viewer experience.

Bhatia will lead the company's global sales and partnerships, aiming to boost revenue across Taboola's product portfolio, which includes its performance advertising platform, publisher partnerships, and generative AI products. He brings extensive experience from previous leadership roles at Amazon and NBCUniversal, where he focused on accelerating growth in technology and media sectors.

summary: V2X Inc. (NYSE:VVX) has secured a position on the $25 billion Advanced Technology Support Program 5 (ATSP5) contract, administered by the Defense Microelectronics Activity. This contract allows V2X to provide engineering and technology solutions to federal and state government agencies, focusing on defense system modernization, obsolescence management, and the development of emerging technologies, including AI. title: Tide Unveils New Type Of Detergent: 'Significant Leap Into The Future'
summary: Procter & Gamble has launched Tide evo, a new dry, fiber-based laundry tile designed as an alternative to Tide Pods and traditional detergents. This innovation, which dissolves instantly in cold water, represents over ten years of development and is positioned as the next significant step in laundry care. Tide evo is gradually rolling out nationwide and is expected to be as impactful as Tide Pods, contributing to Tide's environmental goal of increasing cold-water washes.

title: Is Arlo Technologies ready for primetime?
summary: Roth Capital Markets analyst Scott Searle maintained a "Buy" rating on Arlo Technologies (NASDAQ:ARLO) with a $22.00 price target, citing the company's strong privacy-oriented approach as a key competitive advantage following recent privacy concerns with Amazon-owned Ring. Searle believes that the backlash against Ring's "community requests" feature will benefit Arlo by shifting consumer demand and strengthening partnerships. This move expands Amazon's already substantial presence in the Valley, joining other major tenants like Williams-Sonoma Inc. in the developing 5.5 million-square-foot industrial project. The site is in an industrial hotbed alongside major employers such as Nestle, Red Bull, White Claw, and Walmart.

title: IBM cuts jobs, shifts focus to AI, cloud computing
summary: IBM has announced job cuts, particularly in its marketing and communications division, as it reorients its business toward artificial intelligence and cloud computing. This move aligns with a broader trend in the tech industry, which has seen tens of thousands of job cuts in 2024, as companies like IBM increasingly adopt AI-driven solutions for efficiency and to realign their workforce with high-demand skills. IBM had previously indicated these workforce changes during its Q4 2023 earnings report, aiming to maintain a similar employment level by the end of 2024.

title: Turtle Beach VelocityOne Flightdeck HOTAS review: My new favorite stick for Microsoft Flight Simulator
summary: Ben Wilson reviews the Turtle Beach VelocityOne Flightdeck HOTAS system, an advanced peripheral designed for flight simulators. He praises its extensive customizability, OLED touchscreen, and hall-effect flight stick axes. Although it's a pricey option and lacks pre-made configuration profiles for Microsoft Flight Simulator at launch, its overall performance and features make it his top recommendation for serious flight simulation enthusiasts.

title: ETF Named After Nancy Pelosi, Tracking Congressional Democrats' Stock Trades, Surpasses S&P 500 with Tech Triumph
summary: The Unusual Whales Democratic ETF (NANC), which tracks the stock trades of Democratic members of Congress, has outperformed the S&P 500 since its launch in February 2023, growing 30% compared to the S&P 500's 24%. This success is attributed to significant investments in major tech companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Apple, and Nvidia. The ETF was created amidst ongoing scrutiny of congressional stock trading, and its performance highlights the market's confidence in stocks favored by Democratic lawmakers, including those frequently traded by Nancy Pelosi.

title: Wholesaler's $100m plans for former Amazon warehouse near Watford
summary: Sysco, the world's largest food wholesaler, has announced a $100 million plan to repurpose a former Amazon warehouse in Hemel Hempstead, near Watford, into its largest depot in Europe. This initiative aims to significantly expand Sysco's capacity in the South East of Great Britain and is expected to create 850 jobs over the next decade. The 475,000-square-foot facility, which will include frozen and chilled areas, is projected to be fully operational by early 2026.

title: Equinix Fabric adds multi-cloud routing
summary: Equinix has made its virtual routing service, Fabric Cloud Router, generally available to enterprises leasing its data centers, allowing for in-house multi-cloud connectivity. This service provides Layer 3 connectivity to major cloud providers and other service providers, marketed as a monthly subscription that eliminates the need for physical or virtual routers. Equinix aims to simplify infrastructure complexity for hybrid cloud environments and support emerging technologies like private generative AI, positioning itself against competitors like Megaport with higher bandwidth capabilities.

title: ValueAct Holdings Trims Insight Enterprises by $99 Million as Enterprise IT Budgets Tighten
summary: ValueAct Holdings, L.P. sold over one million shares of Insight Enterprises (NASDAQ:NSIT) in Q4 2025, generating an estimated $98.95 million, as enterprise IT spending faces tightening budgets. The sale reduced ValueAct's stake in NSIT, which now accounts for 1.41% of its AUM and is no longer a top-five holding. This move comes as Insight Enterprises' stock has fallen significantly, highlighting investor concerns about the company's revenue model, which is sensitive to corporate spending shifts.

title: Pinnacle Financial Partners Takes Center Stage as the Exclusive Naming Rights Partner of Nashville Yards’ State-of-the-Art Live Music Venue: “The Pinnacle”
summary: Pinnacle Financial Partners has secured the exclusive naming rights for Nashville Yards' upcoming 4,500-capacity music venue, which will now be known as "The Pinnacle." This long-term agreement deepens Pinnacle's ties to Nashville's entertainment market and the broader community development, with the venue set to open in early 2025. Operated by AEG Presents, The Pinnacle promises a world-class live entertainment experience, reinforcing Nashville's status as a global music hub.

title: Don't miss the opportunity to save £280 on the Garmin Fenix 7X Solar
summary: This article highlights a Cyber Monday deal offering a significant discount of £280 on the Garmin Fenix 7X Solar, reducing its price from £779.99 to £499.99. It details the benefits of the Fenix 7X Solar, particularly its extended battery life, and compares various models within the Garmin Fenix 7 series, including the 7, 7S, and 7 Pro, noting their features and available discounts. The article emphasizes that this is a last-chance opportunity to purchase these premium GPS watches at reduced prices.

title: Top 10 AI Stocks in Focus on Wall Street – Nvidia, Broadcom & More
summary: Erste Group analyst Hans Engel downgraded IBM from Buy to Hold on February 18, 2026, citing slowing infrastructure momentum, weak consulting growth, and financial pressures despite IBM's positive AI outlook. The firm anticipates sideways price action for IBM's stock in the medium term, balancing the company's focus on AI monetization and proprietary AI chips against its recently fallen operating margin and increased long-term liabilities. IBM, a multinational technology company, is a pioneer in artificial intelligence, offering AI consulting and software products.

title: Amazon: AI-assisted hacker breached 600 Fortinet firewalls in 5 weeks
summary: Amazon reports that a Russian-speaking hacker, leveraging generative AI services, breached over 600 FortiGate firewalls across 55 countries in just five weeks. The attacks exploited weak credentials and exposed management interfaces, with AI assisting in automating access, reconnaissance, and attack planning. This campaign demonstrates how AI lowers the barrier to entry for threat actors, enabling less skilled individuals to execute sophisticated attacks.

title: Q3 2023 market & economic outlook
summary: The US economy is akin to a barge, slow to change direction, yet despite aggressive Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, economic data remains strong, with a resilient consumer and labor market. Many economists predicted a recession by now, but a severe downturn is becoming less likely, though sluggish growth may persist. This outlook provides insights into investment views for equities and fixed income, highlighting the impact of AI on market leaders and discussing the inverted yield curve's implications while emphasizing the current housing affordability crisis.

title: JPMorgan Raises its Price Target on McGraw Hill, Inc. (MH) to $22 and Maintains an Overweight Rating
summary: JPMorgan increased its price target on McGraw Hill, Inc. (NYSE:MH) to $22, maintaining an Overweight rating, following strong Q3 results and a raised outlook. Other analysts like Baird and UBS also adjusted their price targets. The company reported better-than-expected Q3 revenue, driven by performance in Higher Education and K-12, and anticipates growth with margin expansion in fiscal 2027.

title: BofA Reinstates Coverage of NIQ Global Intelligence plc (NIQ) with a Buy Rating and a $20 Price Target
summary: BofA analyst Curtis Nagle reinstated coverage of NIQ Global Intelligence plc (NYSE: NIQ) with a Buy rating and a $20 price target, expressing a generally constructive view on the Information and Business Services sector for 2026. This follows Baird analyst Jeffrey Meuler lowering his price target to $20 from $24 due to the unexpected departure of COO Tracey Massey, though NIQ clarified her resignation was for personal reasons and not due to company disagreements, with her responsibilities being absorbed by the CEO and other executives. The article also includes promotional content for an AI stock with "100x upside potential."

title: Beyond the Barcode: Grocery’s Robot Revolution
summary: Robots are increasingly transforming grocery stores and the foodservice industry by handling mundane tasks like inventory monitoring, cleaning, and assisting with food preparation. This automation helps fill labor gaps and allows human employees to focus on more complex customer service roles. While robots excel at efficiency and data reporting, challenges remain, particularly in handling delicate tasks like selecting produce, suggesting a future of symbiotic human-robot partnerships rather than displacement.

title: Avery Dennison Corp.: The ‘Invisible’ Tech Power You’re Sleeping On
summary: Avery Dennison Corp. is a materials and tech company that is rapidly becoming the "invisible" backbone of retail, integrating RFID, NFC, and AI-ready supply chain technologies into everyday shopping and logistics. The company's expansion into digital ID and smart labels for traceability and authenticity is positioning it as a key player in the future of retail infrastructure, attracting attention from Wall Street and major brands. While its core business remains strong, its growth engine is driven by smart solutions that enable faster checkouts, better inventory management, and enhanced product verification for consumers and businesses alike.

title: IonQ Aria Now Available on Amazon Braket
summary: IonQ announced that its most powerful commercial quantum computer, IonQ Aria, is now available on Amazon Braket, Amazon Web Services' quantum computing service. This expands IonQ's presence on the platform, allowing AWS users to choose between IonQ Aria and IonQ Harmony for more complex quantum algorithms. The availability of IonQ Aria, with 25 algorithmic qubits, is expected to enable new approaches in quantum computing across various industries.

title: Customer data stolen from GDS and STT GDC - report
summary: A security firm, Resecurity, has reported an ongoing campaign to steal customer data from data center firms, including GDS Holdings and ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC). The compromised data primarily involved emails and passwords for customer-support websites, affecting around 2,000 customers with prominent companies like Alibaba, Amazon, and Mastercard among them. While both GDS and STT GDC stated the compromised information posed no risk to clients’ critical IT systems or data, Resecurity also found evidence of attempts to gather data on 30,000 CCTV cameras and IT staff credentials.

title: After founder’s exit, The RealReal appoints CEO to lead turnaround
summary: The RealReal, a luxury resale platform, has appointed John Koryl as its new CEO, seven months after founder Julie Wainwright stepped down. Koryl, with experience from Neiman Marcus and Ebay, is tasked with leading the company to profitability. The move comes as The RealReal, like many other fashion companies and resale platforms, faces the challenge of turning its business model profitable despite significant losses in previous years.

title: DXC partners with AWS on Mainframe Modernization services
summary: DXC Technology has partnered with AWS for the launch of the AWS Mainframe Modernization service, aiming to help organizations migrate and modernize mainframe applications on the AWS cloud. Leveraging its expertise as an AWS Premier Consulting Partner, DXC offers assessments and full-stack managed services to accelerate migrations, reduce costs, and foster innovation. The service provides tools for assessing, building, migrating, modernizing, and deploying applications, with DXC providing industrialized delivery and consulting to ensure successful transformations and business benefits like cost reduction and digital enablement.

title: Omnicom Media Group Outperforms in Forrester's Evaluation of Global Media Services
summary: Omnicom Media Group (OMG) has achieved the highest current offering score in Forrester Research's recent evaluation of global media services. The holding company, which includes OMD, PHD, and Hearts & Science, led in six key areas: retail media, commerce, audience intelligence, optimization, innovation road map, and operations automation, showcasing its strong performance and capabilities.

title: CSP Multicloud Security: Elevate Success Across All Clouds
summary: Palo Alto Networks provides multicloud security solutions that integrate with leading Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) like AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle, and Alibaba. The company emphasizes a platform approach to address the complexities and security risks of diverse multicloud environments, offering comprehensive visibility, control, and compliance through its next-gen security platforms. These solutions range from best-in-class network security and cloud-native app development protection to AI-powered software firewalls and advanced threat intelligence, with free trials available for various offerings.

title: Here is What Leads to Attractive Upside on LiveRamp Holdings (RAMP)
summary: LiveRamp Holdings (NYSE: RAMP) is highlighted as a small-cap software infrastructure stock with attractive upside potential, despite recent price target reductions by analysts like DA Davidson and Benchmark. Analysts maintained "Buy" ratings, forecasting significant upside potential, fueled by strong quarterly performance exceeding expectations, though management projects softer marketplace growth. The company provides a privacy-focused data collaboration platform, and the article also briefly discusses the broader AI market and a potentially promising AI stock with high upside potential.

title: Stanley Black & Decker to slash SKUs, footprint in $1.5B savings plan
summary: Stanley Black & Decker plans a major supply chain overhaul to achieve $1.5 billion in cost savings over three years. This involves cutting its product portfolio by 40%, reducing its manufacturing footprint by 30%, and standardizing components to simplify sourcing complexity. The move aims to address bloated inventory levels caused by softer consumer demand and to improve agility by positioning manufacturing closer to customers.

title: Ready to Automate? 5 Expert Insights on the Warehouse of the Future
summary: This article explores five expert insights on warehouse automation, emphasizing augmentation over replacement of human workers. It highlights the importance of anticipating future throughput requirements, adopting a data-centric approach, integrating management systems, and challenging existing assumptions about automation. The piece underlines how automation can enhance efficiency and solve creative problems in distribution centers.

title: 3 Reasons AIG is Risky and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
summary: This article analyzes why American International Group (AIG) is considered a risky investment. It highlights declining net premiums earned, weak EPS growth, and substandard book value per share growth as the primary concerns. The article suggests investors look for more timely opportunities and recommends other high-quality stocks instead of AIG.

title: Princeton Capital Management LLC Sells 13,577 Shares of Marvell Technology, Inc. $MRVL
summary: Princeton Capital Management LLC significantly reduced its stake in Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) by selling 13,577 shares, representing a 49.7% decrease in its holdings. Despite this, other institutional investors increased their positions, and analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for the semiconductor company with a consensus price target of $115.16, following strong Q3 earnings and revenue growth.

title: Favorable Application SaaS Outlook Bodes Well for Five9 (FIVN)
summary: Five9 Incorporated (FIVN), a small-cap software infrastructure stock, is highlighted for its favorable outlook, despite recent price target reductions by Morgan Stanley and Barclays analysts. Analysts attribute the positive shift to a more benign AI-related risk environment for Application SaaS companies. The company, which provides cloud-based contact center solutions, still offers significant upside potential according to these analysts.

title: Blackstone Inc. $BX Shares Acquired by Lansforsakringar Fondforvaltning AB publ
summary: Lansforsakringar Fondforvaltning AB publ increased its stake in Blackstone Inc. (NYSE:BX) by 4.6% in the third quarter, acquiring an additional 9,999 shares. Other institutional investors also adjusted their holdings. The article further details recent news impacting Blackstone, including positive sentiment from an acquisition, neutral sentiment regarding portfolio trades and analyst ratings, and negative sentiment due to liquidity shocks in private credit and elevated bearish options positioning.

title: Teladoc Health Faces Significant Challenges Ahead
summary: Teladoc Health is facing significant challenges, including a severe decline in market value, intense competition from companies like Amazon, and profitability issues despite its pandemic-era growth. Analysts are largely pessimistic about its future outlook, with some predicting further stock price declines. The company's international expansion is outpacing domestic growth but comes with cost pressures, and it struggles with securing broad health insurance coverage for its services.

title: Amazon (AMZN) Feels Misunderstood, Says Jim Cramer
summary: Jim Cramer discussed Amazon's (AMZN) cash flow and the sentiment surrounding data centers, noting that despite strong operating income and AWS growth, the company's significant capital expenditure on data centers has led to a perceived decline in its balance sheet. He believes Amazon feels misunderstood regarding its high spending, especially as data centers face criticism. Analysts Bernstein and Benchmark recently cut Amazon's price targets due to these capital expenditure concerns.

summary: Lansforsakringar Fondforvaltning AB publ increased its stake in Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MRVL) by 4.5% in the third quarter, acquiring an additional 16,257 shares and bringing its total holdings to 377,220 shares valued at $31,713,000. Insider activity saw EVP Mark Casper sell 5,000 shares, while analysts have a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating with an average price target of $115.16 for MRVL.

title: Lob launches direct mail automation platform
summary: Lob, a direct mail automation vendor, has released a new no-code web platform to help marketers automate direct mail campaigns. The platform leverages marketing automation data to target specific audiences, reducing costs and environmental impact while capitalizing on renewed interest in direct mail among millennials. Marley Spoon, a meal-kit vendor, is an existing Lob customer that has found success using direct mail for customer acquisition and reactivation.

title: Charter goes big at the edge
summary: Charter's Spectrum Enterprise unit is expanding its edge services market by introducing "Enterprise Network Edge" (ENE) for larger customers. This new platform integrates advanced security and SD-WAN capabilities, managed through a cloud-based portal, and includes secure connectivity to major cloud providers. ENE aims to address the increasing demand for sophisticated networking solutions and enhanced security in a post-pandemic business environment, building on the success of its SMB-focused Managed Network Edge (MNE) offering.

title: FedEx Corp. founder Fred Smith will step down as CEO in June
summary: Fred Smith, the founder of FedEx Corp., will step down as CEO on June 1, 2022, and transition to executive chairman. Raj Subramaniam, current president and chief operating officer, will succeed him as CEO. Smith, who started FedEx in 1973, will focus on global issues, while Subramaniam, who joined the company in 1991, will take the helm of operations.

title: Here’s What Analysts Think About Bunge Global SA (BG)
summary: Bunge Global SA (NYSE:BG) recently received several price target upgrades and reaffirmed Buy/Overweight ratings from JPMorgan, UBS, Stephens, and BMO Capital on February 5. Analysts cited a fiscal Q4 earnings beat and strong growth levers as reasons for their positive outlook. The company is actively involved in agribusiness, food production, sugarcane processing, and ethanol production, with segments covering milling and refined/specialty oils.

title: IonQ Aria Achieves Record 20 Algorithmic Qubits
summary: IonQ announced that its quantum computer, IonQ Aria, has achieved a record 20 algorithmic qubits (#AQ), positioning it as the industry's most powerful quantum computer based on application-oriented benchmarks. The company has published a detailed blog post to further define the #AQ metric and explain IonQ Aria's benchmarking results compared to its peers. IonQ Aria demonstrates superior capability in executing quantum circuits, with over 550 gates compared to dozens for superconducting systems, enabling practical applications in various sectors.

title: Rigetti Computing's 80-Qubit System Now Commercially Available, Reports on CLOPS Speed Tests
summary: Rigetti Holdings announced the commercial availability of its 80-qubit quantum system, Aspen-M, through Rigetti Quantum Cloud Services and other platforms like Amazon Braket. The company also reported speed test results using the CLOPS metric, showing competitive performance for Aspen-M and its 40-qubit Aspen-11 system compared to IBM's published scores. These results highlight Rigetti's multi-chip technology's ability to scale and maintain system speed as qubit counts increase.

title: Analysts Maintain Buy on Amazon (AMZN) Despite 18% Share Depreciation
summary: Despite Amazon (AMZN) experiencing an 18% share depreciation from February 2 to February 13, 2026, and losing $450 billion in market capitalization, analysts are maintaining a "Buy" rating on the stock. This depreciation is linked to investor scrutiny over the company's significant $200 billion investment plan in AI and robotics for 2026. However, Bank of America analyst Justin Post supports the spending, noting Amazon's competitive advantage with AWS.

title: Oracle stock drops 5% as OpenAI funding story shifts again — what to watch next week
summary: Oracle shares dropped 5.4% following renewed attention on OpenAI's substantial funding needs and its potential impact on cloud revenue for companies like Oracle. Nvidia is reportedly pursuing a significant investment in OpenAI, which is seeking over $100 billion in fresh funding, potentially valuing the AI startup at $830 billion. Investors are now closely watching Nvidia's upcoming earnings report for insights into AI demand and Oracle's ability to translate its new AI infrastructure into revenue amidst market volatility and shifting trade policies.

title: Sell… Sell… Sell… Another Eight Companies Insiders Are Exiting
summary: Insiders are increasingly selling off their company stocks, extending beyond tech and airlines to other sectors like cruise lines and trucking. This suggests growing market fears and a potentially overvalued market, with some "smart money" investors pulling out. The article highlights eight companies where significant insider selling is occurring, particularly in industries sensitive to consumer demand shifts and those facing existential threats from AI.

title: Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) Named Top AI Pick as Morgan Stanley Sees AWS Acceleration and Agentic Upside
summary: Morgan Stanley has named Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) as a top AI pick, reiterating its "Overweight" rating and a $300 price target. The firm believes Amazon's AWS and Retail segments are underappreciated GenAI winners, expecting AWS revenue growth to exceed 30% and highlighting Agentic Commerce as another catalyst. Despite current market narratives and questions about return on invested capital, Morgan Stanley remains bullish on AMZN's potential in the AI space.

title: Morgan Stanley Raises Travel + Leisure (TNL) Price Target to $80
summary: Morgan Stanley has increased its price target for Travel + Leisure Co. (TNL) to $80 from $68, maintaining an Overweight rating. The firm anticipates similar underlying trends in 2026 for gaming, lodging, and leisure, with TNL favorably positioned due to its customer demographic and recurring revenue model. Travel + Leisure Co. reported robust financial results in Q3 2025, including $111 million in net income and $1.04 billion in net revenue, alongside strategic brand expansions.

title: Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) Named Top AI Pick as Morgan Stanley Sees AWS Acceleration and Agentic Upside
summary: Morgan Stanley has named Amazon (AMZN) a top AI pick, reiterating an "Overweight" rating and a $300 price target, seeing its AWS and Retail divisions as underappreciated GenAI winners. The firm anticipates AWS revenue growth to exceed 30%, supported by strong enterprise demand and increased capital expenditures. Additionally, Agentic Commerce and AI-powered shopping assistants are expected to drive further upside, despite the stock trading at a discount compared to peers.

title: Amazon (AMZN) Feels Misunderstood, Says Jim Cramer
summary: Jim Cramer believes Amazon (AMZN) feels misunderstood, especially concerning its negative free cash flow and significant capital expenditures, which analysts have questioned. Despite strong operating income and AWS growth, firms like Bernstein and Benchmark have reduced price targets for Amazon shares due to these concerns. Cramer emphasizes his strong position in Amazon, while also noting the public perception issues around data centers.

title: Kroger Stock: What You Need To Know Today
summary: This article provides an in-depth look at Kroger (KR) stock, covering its market position as a major US retailer and key factors influencing its share price. It discusses the impact of earnings reports, fierce industry competition, economic conditions like inflation, and strategic company news such as the proposed Albertsons merger. The analysis also delves into Kroger's financial performance, including revenue, profitability, and future outlook based on strategic initiatives.

title: Apple Faces Revenue Challenge as Judge Orders App Store Changes
summary: A federal judge has ordered Apple to allow developers to direct consumers to outside payment methods, challenging the company's 30% commission on App Store transactions. While the ruling found Apple engaged in anticompetitive conduct by preventing developers from offering cheaper prices, it stopped short of declaring the App Store a monopoly or allowing third-party app marketplaces. This decision, though not going as far as Epic Games sought, is a significant setback for Apple and adds to global pressure from regulators regarding its market dominance.

title: Walmart Inc. $WMT Shares Purchased by Westerkirk Capital Inc.
summary: Westerkirk Capital Inc. increased its stake in Walmart (WMT) by 88.9% in the third quarter, acquiring an additional 15,400 shares. Despite slightly beating Q4 EPS and revenue estimates, Walmart's guidance for FY 2027 and Q1 fell below consensus, leading to a recent stock selloff. The company maintains a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating with a target price of $132.53, and has increased its annual dividend to $0.99.

title: Garmin Stock Is Moving Again – What That Means For Your Next Watch
summary: Garmin Ltd. is gaining significant attention due to strong earnings and advancements in AI-fueled fitness technology. The company, known for its durable hardware and robust fitness ecosystems, is positioning itself as a strong alternative to Apple and Samsung for serious athletes and outdoor enthusiasts. The article highlights that Garmin's focus on performance, long battery life, and specialized training tools makes it a compelling choice for both consumers and investors.

title: 2 film streaming stocks we like
summary: This article identifies ViacomCBS (VIAC) and Discovery (DISCA) as two promising streaming stocks, preferring them over Netflix due to perceived overvaluation and increasing competition. It highlights ViacomCBS's content breadth, successful Paramount+ relaunch, and growing Pluto TV, while praising Discovery's unique content library and potential for accelerated streaming adoption through its merger with WarnerMedia. The author believes traditional media firms are well-positioned to compete with Netflix due to existing content, franchises, and customer relationships.

title: What’s Behind the Value-Growth Performance Gap?
summary: Global value stocks exhibit a near-record discount to growth stocks despite recent outperformance, raising questions about the drivers of this valuation gap. The article analyzes returns from 2015-2020, revealing that multiple expansion, rather than earnings growth or dividends, primarily accounted for growth stocks' significant outperformance. It also explores why value earnings have lagged and why the value discount widened, attributing it to falling interest rates, increased premium for revenue growth, and diverging risk premiums.

title: HDFC Bank acquires 10% stake in CSC Grameen, launches AI chatbot Eva
summary: HDFC Bank has acquired a 10% stake in CSC Grameen e-Store, a special purpose vehicle of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, to expand financial services in rural and semi-urban areas. Alongside this investment, HDFC Bank launched its AI chatbot 'Eva' on CSC's Digital Seva Portal to help Village Level Entrepreneurs (VLEs) learn about bank products. This partnership aims to bridge the digital gap between urban and rural India by leveraging the CSC network for various banking and e-commerce services.

title: Logical Partners: T-Mobile, Lumen Join Forces on 5G Edge Computing
summary: T-Mobile and Lumen have announced a partnership to combine T-Mobile's 5G mobile network with Lumen's edge computing infrastructure. This collaboration aims to provide enterprises with extended application capabilities, leveraging Lumen's extensive fiber network and data centers, and T-Mobile's leading 5G footprint. The deal strategically addresses the complementary strengths of both companies, with Lumen lacking a mobile business and T-Mobile lacking extensive wireline infrastructure, at a time when edge computing is crucial for low-latency 5G applications.

title: Corsair K65 RGB Mini keyboard review
summary: The Corsair K65 RGB Mini is a compact 60% mechanical gaming keyboard designed for portability and impressive per-key RGB backlighting. While it excels in gaming performance with its fast Cherry MX RGB Red switches and 8,000Hz hyper-polling rate, its lack of dedicated arrow and function keys makes it less ideal for everyday typing tasks. Despite its high price, it offers onboard profile storage and a sturdy design, making it a strong contender for competitive gamers prioritizing a small form factor.

title: Small cloud company DigitalOcean raises $775m in IPO, but shares drop on open
summary: DigitalOcean, a cloud computing company, raised over $775 million in its initial public offering but saw its shares drop by about 10 percent shortly after trading began, valuing the company at $4.48 billion. The company emphasizes simplicity in cloud computing for developers and businesses, operating 14 leased data centers globally. Despite year-on-year revenue growth to $318 million in 2020, losses also increased to $44 million.

title: ‘Caillou’ sale, streaming surge help to boost PBS budget far above expectations
summary: PBS significantly exceeded its budgeted net income for the first half of the fiscal year, earning $27.2 million against a projection of $200,000. This surplus was driven by one-time gains from the sale of interest in the "Caillou" program and a settlement with Dish Network, along with increased streaming revenue from PBS Distribution, particularly from its PBS Documentaries channel on Amazon Prime, and reduced operating costs due to the pandemic. The financial update highlighted PBS's strong fiscal position with no debt and high station dues collection rates.

title: Amazon Net Income By Year: FY 1996 to 2020
summary: The article details Amazon's net income from fiscal year 1996 to 2020, highlighting its financial growth. Amazon reported its highest annual net profit of $21,331 million in 2020, with an 84.1% year-over-year increase. The company transitioned from significant losses in the late 1990s to sustained profitability, particularly exceeding $10 billion in net profit by 2018.

summary: Breakable chocolate hearts are gaining popularity as a Valentine's Day gift, initially popularized by Kim Kardashian. title: Shawn Springs: From Idea to Impact
summary: This article features an interview with Shawn Springs, former NFL player and founder/CEO of Windpact, a company specializing in impact protection technology. Springs discusses how his personal experiences with traumatic brain injury in sports and the entrepreneurial spirit he observed in Seattle inspired him to create Windpact. He shares insights on building a business, securing funding, and expanding his vision from sports protection to military and automotive applications, emphasizing the importance of a strong team and adaptability.

title: TD Cowen Reiterates Buy on American Electric Power (AEP), Cites Improving Execution
summary: TD Cowen analyst Shelby Tucker reiterated a Buy rating on American Electric Power (AEP) and raised its price target to $141 from $137, citing improving execution and a strong pipeline of investment opportunities. The company's CEO highlighted AEP's presence in high-growth regions, infrastructure investments, and solid Q4 2025 operating earnings of $1.19 per share, with full-year operating earnings at $5.97 per share, exceeding guidance. AEP also raised its quarterly dividend to $0.95 per share and delivered a 29% total shareholder return for 2025.

summary: This article summarizes the recent ecommerce earnings reports from Yeti and La-Z-Boy, highlighting Yeti's net sales increase driven by ecommerce and AI, and La-Z-Boy's overall sales growth despite struggles with its Joybird brand. It also briefly touches upon the earnings of other major retailers like Etsy, Walmart, and Wayfair, indicating trends in online sales and the impact of AI.

title: Diary of A CEO: with Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi (Transcript)
summary: This article provides a full transcript of a "Diary of a CEO" podcast interview with Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi. Khosrowshahi discusses his journey from being born in Iran and his family losing everything, shaping his drive to rebuild and never take things for granted. He also delves into transforming Uber into a profitable company, the importance of hard work and transparency, and the profound societal impact of AI and autonomous vehicles, including potential job displacement for millions of drivers.

title: AHEAD To Acquire RoundTower, Kovarus, Creating $2.1 Billion Channel Behemoth
summary: AHEAD, a digital transformation-focused solution provider, announced its acquisition of RoundTower Technologies and Kovarus. This strategic move aims to create a nationwide IT services powerhouse with over $2.1 billion in revenue and more than 1,000 employees, significantly expanding AHEAD's cloud and ServiceNow practices and its geographical reach. The combined entity is expected to enhance service offerings for customers and vendor partners, leveraging existing strong relationships with Dell, VMware, and Cisco.

title: Ubiquiti UniFi Dream Machine review: This is the router you've been looking for
summary: The Ubiquiti UniFi Dream Machine is reviewed as an ideal router for home networking, offering extensive configuration options, excellent Wi-Fi range, and robust hardware. While it uses Wi-Fi 5 instead of Wi-Fi 6, its prosumer features, scalability, and ease of setup for a Ubiquiti ecosystem make it a standout choice for tinkerers and general users alike, despite its premium price point. The article highlights its strong performance and reliability over two weeks of testing.

title: The Contrarian Investment Case for Russian Stocks
summary: This article argues for a contrarian investment approach to Russian stocks, highlighting their outperformance against U.S. equities over five years despite geopolitical issues and volatile oil prices. The author points to low valuations, attractive dividend yields from companies like Lukoil and Sberbank, and growth potential in internet firms like Yandex, as key reasons for investment.
